records.title: Director Mission Assurance 1
records.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems is looking for a
**Director Mission Assurance 1**
to lead the Quality and Mission Assurance organization for the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This leadership role is located in
**Roy, Utah**
. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills to lead in a dynamic engineering and production environment. There is significant responsibility and visibility with executive leadership and the broad customer organization.
 
 
**What You'll Get To Do**

* Defines and monitors mission assurance program specifications and processes to ensure mission success of programs.
* Performs or assures quality, risk management, safety, reliability and maintainability of program achievements, subcontractors, and suppliers in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Assesses program performance and risks and determines resources to ensure mission assurance.
* Ensures the on-time delivery of high-quality products and services that meet all contractual requirements and business objectives.
* Drives the continuous improvement of people (to include training & development), products, processes, systems and services through the application of world class manufacturing to include innovative technologies, lean principles, six-sigma projects, and common best practices.
* Develops, maintains, and ensures compliance with mission assurance programs, policies, processes, procedures and that the performance and quality of products/processes conform to established standards, specifications and agency guidelines.
* Provides expertise and guidance in interpreting policies, regulatory and/or governmental regulations, and agency guidelines to assure compliance.
* Provides leadership that fosters an inclusive, motivated and engaged work culture.
* Supports the development phase of programs by assuring engineering products and processes conform to internal and customer requirements.
* Works directly with operating entities such as engineering and manufacturing to ensure that inspections, process control analyses and audits are conducted on a continuing basis to enforce requirements and compliance.
* Ensures the Quality/Mission Assurance, Manufacturing, and Engineering processes are consistent with industry capability maturity models and QMS standards (AS9100).
* Provides direct oversight in all efforts related to factory accountability and foreign object elimination practices.
* Reviews trend metrics and analyze misses in order to implement the appropriate improvements to improve performance.
* Standardizes and facilitate root cause / corrective action efforts to resolve quality issues.

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:
 
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.
 
 
**You’ll Bring These Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of related technical experience or a Masters with 8 years of experience
* Demonstrated experience developing, communicating and instituting new processes for an organization
* Experience managing people
* 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Mission Assurance specific roles
* 5 years of experience in metric development for process health and performance monitoring large programs/projects
* Leadership experience in both EMD and Production programs
* Active US Government Secret Clearance adjudicated in the last 6 years with ability to obtain SAP and Top-Secret Clearance

**These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have**

* 10 years Executive Leadership experience, preferably within the Aerospace and Defense industry
* NG QMS familiarity
* ISO 9001 and AS9100 familiarity
* MS or MBA degree highly preferred
* Active Top Secret Clearance

Primary Level Salary Range: $182,500.00 - $273,500.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

records.title: Director of Quality-Operations
records.description:
**About Us:**
BW Papersystems, part of the Barry-Wehmiller Group, builds capital equipment that transforms paper into products for consumers - every day, around the world. We offer innovative technologies, service and parts, and years of global experience in corrugating, finishing; slitting and packaging; stationery; bookbinding and security documents. Customers rely on our machines to produce and convert items such as corrugated boxes, folding cartons, passports, notebooks, copy paper, board, and coated and other specialty papers. For more information, visit bwpapersystems.com.
 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
 
 
**Job Description:**
The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy. In this critical role, the Director of Quality will be the leader in developing and maintaining a quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction, and to increase profitability in a safe working environment.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the management team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy.
* Develop and maintain a business/quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction and increase profitability in a safe working environment within the local business.
* Continuously assess the overall Quality Management System, Quality Plan and Quality Organization to determine priorities for quality improvement.
* Establish the key improvement priorities, and using a strategy deployment approach, develop and execute a cross-functional, strategic action plan to drive improvement.
* Identify the leading sources of customer dissatisfaction.
* Determine the underlying causes and develop/execute strategies to eliminate those causes.
* Determine the true, systemic root causes of internal failure and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Execute a strategy consisting of well-planned and executed preventive actions that reduce COPQ and other forms of waste.
* Drive improvements in process quality, production efficiency, and the elimination of the factors that drive variability and unforeseen disruptions.
* Drive a strategy that incorporates standard work, effective training, and recurring process audits to ensure process discipline.
* Establish and maintain appropriate KPIs that provide objective evidence of improvement
* Participate in training and coaching teams in the standard quality improvement approach and quality management standard requirements to develop organizational capability.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, quality, continuous improvement, or related field.
* 10+ years of professional experience leading a Quality Organization in capital equipment manufacturing environment.
* Experience with the execution of continuous improvement methodology such as Operational Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Strategy Deployment, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

* Requires the ability to independently resolve complex problems.
* Requires ability to manage a skilled and diverse staff, communicate effectively, represent the organization, act decisively, and influence decisions of senior managers and customers.
* Requires foresight to anticipate problems and recognize opportunities for cost-effectively improving operations.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
* Decision Quality – Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

*The approximate pay range for this position is $155,000 to $210,000 base salary. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.*
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.
 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.
 
 
**Company:**
BW Papersystems

records.title: Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
**About this Director of Quality Assurance role:**

The Director, Quality Assurance provides strategic leadership for the company's quality organization and Quality Management System across multiple locations. This position is responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory and customer compliance, and the effectiveness and integrity of quality systems supporting both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume manufacturing operations. The Director leads the development of the quality organization, drives continuous improvement and operational excellence, and partners with cross-functional leadership to strengthen quality performance and support the organization's growth.

**Reports to:**
VP Operations & QA

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the quality organization across all company locations.
* Maintain and continually develop the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring process integrity and compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and industry requirements, including AS9100 and ISO 9001.
* Establish quality strategies, standards, and control plans that support product quality, operational performance, and customer requirements.
* Lead and develop the Quality team, establishing clear expectations and building organizational capability to support current and future business needs.
* Monitor and analyze quality and manufacturing performance metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen product quality, reduce scrap and rework, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Drive effective corrective and preventive actions and promote systematic problem-solving to address quality issues and prevent recurrence.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to improve product and process quality throughout the organization.
* Ensure products and processes meet applicable customer, regulatory, contractual, and company quality requirements.
* Provide leadership and oversight for customer quality issues, supplier quality performance, audits, and other significant quality matters.
* Maintain organizational readiness for customer, registrar, and regulatory audits and ensure appropriate resolution of identified findings.
* Support capital planning, equipment investments, facility needs, and long-term manufacturing strategies from a quality and operational risk perspective.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Comply with all company policies and applicable quality, safety, cybersecurity, customer, and regulatory requirements, including ITAR/export control, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) handling, and Foreign Object Damage (FOD) prevention.
* Complete all required training and use approved methods to protect company and customer information.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible quality leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading quality operations across multiple locations.
* Experience supporting both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality organizations through periods of significant growth and operational change.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Quality Management Systems and applicable quality standards, including AS9100 and ISO 9001.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* US Citizen, Permanent Resident, or Protected Individual (as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)) preferred due to ITAR responsibilities.
* ASQ certification such as Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with government contracting quality requirements.
* Lean/Six Sigma certification or demonstrated continuous improvement experience.
* Experience scaling quality systems to support organizational growth.

Our client is an equal opportunity employer.

records.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!
 
 
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Simsbury, CT
 
 
**Reports to:**
VP of Operations
 
 
**Industry:**
Aerospace & Defense
 
 
**Experience Level:**
Director (15+ years)
 
 
**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**
At
**Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),**
we’ve been innovating for nearly
**200 years,**
delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.
 
 
We’re seeking a dynamic
**Director of Quality**
to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.
 
 
**The Opportunity:**
EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 
 
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.
 
 
**Core Competencies for Success:**

* Quality & Compliance Leadership: Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.
* Continuous Improvement & Performance: Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* Team Development & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* Collaboration & Influence: Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* Legacy: Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* Impact: Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* Partnership: Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* Culture of Excellence: Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.
 
 
**Compensation and Rewards:**
We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:
 
 
**Base Salary:**
$175k – $225k plus annual bonus
 
 
**Executive Relocation:**
Comprehensive support for a seamless transition
 
 
**Additional Enhancements:**
Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience
 
 
*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*
*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Position Overview:

A well-established precision manufacturer in the aerospace and defense sector is seeking a Director of Quality to lead its quality management systems across casting, machining, and assembly operations. This leadership role is critical to ensuring compliance with industry regulations, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining the highest standards of quality in production.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop, implement, and maintain a robust Quality Management System (QMS) aligned with AS9100, ISO 9001, and Nadcap standards.
* Lead internal and external audits, customer quality interactions, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
* Oversee dimensional and metallurgical inspection processes, including CMM, GD&T, and non-destructive testing.
* Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (RCCM, 8D, CAPA).
* Manage all First Article Inspection (FAI) and PPAP/APQP activities, including documentation under AS9012 and AS13002.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, supply chain) to improve process capability and product quality.
* Analyze quality KPIs and initiate continuous improvement programs to reduce scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field required; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive quality leadership experience in aerospace, defense, or high-precision manufacturing.
* Extensive knowledge of quality standards and regulatory frameworks: AS9100, ISO 9001, Nadcap, ITAR.
* Experience managing audits and customer approvals (e.g., Boeing, Lockheed, Raytheon, Honeywell).
* Strong background in metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing.
* Familiar with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma methodologies, and ERP systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

* Competitive salary and executive-level benefits package.
* Long-term growth opportunity within a stable and highly respected organization.
* Role is on-site and not eligible for remote work.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Job Title:**
Quality Director

**Job Description:**

Element Staffing is recruiting for an experienced
**Quality Director**
for a major food manufacturing company in the southern Chicago suburbs. The Quality Director will oversee quality in several locations and run all compliance programs.
**Local candidates only.**

**Duties/Responsibilities/Qualifications:**

* Provide strategic oversight of food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance across multiple manufacturing facilities.
* Build and lead a high-performing quality organization by coaching site leadership, developing talent, and establishing consistent performance expectations.
* Drive the organization's food safety and quality strategy, ensuring alignment with applicable regulations, industry standards, and customer requirements.
* Establish and strengthen quality assurance programs, including preventive controls, food safety plans, audit readiness, and certification requirements.
* Oversee supplier quality and risk management activities, ensuring vendors and business partners meet established safety and quality standards.
* Guide product integrity and compliance initiatives, including product specifications, labeling, technical documentation, and specialized certification programs.
* Serve as a key resource for customer quality matters, addressing technical requests, product concerns, corrective actions, and compliance documentation.
* Champion continuous improvement through quality metrics, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, internal audits, and management reviews.
* Oversee organizational preparedness for product recalls, food safety incidents, and other business-critical quality events.
* Manage departmental strategy, staffing, and financial resources while collaborating with senior leadership and operational teams to advance business objectives
* Communicate quality system status of the company through management reviews & quality audits.
* Interact with QC staff and management to recommend collaborative improvement efforts.
* Must possess strong knowledge and certifications in HACCP, SQF, PCQI, FSMA, etc.

**Additional Information:**

* **Years of Experience:**
 5-7+ years of quality management experience in USDA / FDA facility
* **Education:**
 BA/BS in Chemistry, Food Science, Microbiology or any other related sciences
* **Shift/Travel:**
 1st shift. Oversee other shifts.
* **Compensation:**
 $140-$150K+ DOE
* **Assignment Type:**
 Direct Hire
* **Location:**
 Southern Chicago Suburbs

records.title: Vice President Quality Control
records.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Quality Control based in the United States.**
The Vice President, Quality Control will provide strategic leadership for a global laboratory network supporting clinical development and commercial manufacturing programs. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, this executive will define and implement an enterprise-wide Quality Control strategy, ensuring scientific excellence, regulatory compliance, reliable data, and timely product release. The role oversees a broad range of laboratory operations across multiple sites and product modalities, while driving standardization, digital transformation, and operational performance. Working closely with senior executives, strategic clients, and regulatory authorities, the successful candidate will influence investment decisions, strengthen inspection readiness, and protect continuity of supply. This is an opportunity to shape a high-performing global organization and make a meaningful contribution to product quality and patient safety.
 
 
Accountabilities
 
 

* Define and execute the global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap across sites, product modalities, and development stages. Establish consistent enterprise standards, governance structures, and decision-making responsibilities while accommodating justified site-specific requirements.
* Provide executive oversight of end-to-end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw-material, in-process, release, and stability testing, as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure laboratory capacity, priorities, and execution support program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure testing strategies and specifications evolve appropriately throughout clinical development, process performance qualification, product launch, and commercial supply.
* Establish global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance and integrity, laboratory investigations, out-of-specification and out-of-trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise-level regulatory inspection strategies and responses to critical client audits.
* Drive the global laboratory digital and technology roadmap, including laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated technology deployment, master-data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption to improve accuracy, efficiency, and cycle times.
* Lead enterprise capacity planning, capital investment prioritization, make-versus-buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and oversight of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resilience requirements.
* Establish enterprise performance metrics and management reviews covering testing and release timelines, lead times, invalid results, out-of-specification and out-of-trend rates, investigation cycle times, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Promote risk-based decision-making, Lean practices, and cross-site learning.
* Act as the senior Quality Control representative for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex technical and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate scientifically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic and consistently delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Develop organizational capabilities, succession plans, technical career paths, and communities of practice while fostering scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Lead escalations and coordinated responses to significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, data-integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk-based decisions regarding testing strategies, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform additional responsibilities in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and organizational objectives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 15 years of progressive Quality Control experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) sector; alternatively, a Master's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* At least 10 years of people-management experience, including a minimum of five years leading senior leaders with responsibility for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control operations across clinical development and commercial manufacturing, including analytical method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience managing global regulatory inspections and client audits, as well as complex out-of-specification, out-of-trend, data-integrity, and laboratory-compliance matters.
* Experience overseeing budgets, capital investment portfolios, headcount, laboratory capacity, external testing partners, and enterprise transformation initiatives within a complex, matrixed global organization.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and client-facing skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and regulatory matters clearly and influence strategic decisions.
* An advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration is preferred.
* Global leadership experience within a CDMO supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing is highly desirable.
* Experience scaling Quality Control capabilities from clinical development through process performance qualification, product launch, and sustained commercial supply is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of relevant regulatory authorities, standards, and guidance, including the US Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, and Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency.
* Familiarity with International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; and applicable data-integrity expectations.
* Experience implementing global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation initiatives is preferred.
* Professional credentials from the American Society for Quality, along with Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent quality and operational excellence training, are valued.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $272,000–$325,000, with compensation determined by work location and relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
* Health Savings Account option with company contributions.
* Industry-leading 401(k) savings plan.
* Insurance coverage and employee assistance programs.
* Wellness incentives designed to support overall health and well-being.
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays.
* A supportive environment that encourages personal and professional development.
* Global scope, with the role supporting sites worldwide. Compensation and benefits are governed by the location designated as the employee's home site.

**How Jobgether Works**
We use an
**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
 
 
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 
 
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
 
 
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
 
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.title: VP Operations
records.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions.
 
 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence.
 
 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
include, but not limited to the following.
 
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
 
 
Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.
 
 
Powered by JazzHR

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
**Vice President Quality**

**Global Product Distribution Quality**

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
 Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
 Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
 Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
 Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**
 Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Sitting or Recent Med-Tech VP:**
 Minimum 10 years of global organizational leadership at the Vice President level within medical devices, capital equipment, or adjacent life sciences—ready to deliver impact from day one.
* **Post-Manufacturing & 3PL Mastery:**
 Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).
* **Proven Remediation Track Record:**
 Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.
* **Global Trade & Customs Compliance:**
 Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.
* **Academic Foundation:**
 Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
VP of Quality – Structural Steel & Bridge Fabrication

**Confidential Fabricator**

The cost of poor quality rarely sits in one department.

Production loses hours to repairs.

Project managers spend time chasing answers.

Shipping loses its window.

And the customer remembers who had to explain the delay.

That’s when quality becomes a leadership issue.

A large-scale structural steel and bridge fabricator is hiring a
**VP of Quality**
to set the quality strategy and make it work across engineering, fabrication and project delivery.

You’ll set expectations with department leaders, use data on rework and audit findings to decide where to act first, and build a quality team that can support the business as it grows.

You’ll need the technical credibility to challenge a welding or inspection decision and the judgment to know when a recurring issue calls for investment, a process change or clearer ownership.

**What they’re looking for**

* Senior quality leadership in structural steel, bridge fabrication or comparable heavy welded fabrication
* Experience owning a quality management system and leading quality managers or inspection teams
* Strong knowledge of AWS D1.1, AWS D1.5 and AISC certification requirements
* Evidence of measurable improvements in rework, delivery performance or customer outcomes
* Confidence representing the business with customers, auditors and third-party inspectors

**Why it’s worth a conversation**

* Executive influence over how quality decisions are made across the business
* State-of-the-art facility: 2000+ tonnes a month
* Complex steel and bridge work where those decisions have a real impact on cost and delivery
* Scope to shape the quality team, systems and standards as the business grows

If you’ve changed how a fabrication business manages quality, I’d like to hear what you changed and what improved.

**Apply on LinkedIn or message me directly for a confidential conversation.**

records.title: Head of Quality Assurance
records.description:
This role offers the chance to grow with a respected Nutraceutical CDMO in a fulltime, Monday to Friday position. You’ll be joining a stable expanding company where quality is a top priority.

**Position Title**

Head of Quality

**Position Purpose and Objectives**

The Head of Quality will re‑energize and elevate the company’s quality organization, ensuring exceptional compliance, product integrity, and operational excellence across all manufacturing activities. This role is responsible for setting the strategic direction for quality systems, leading continuous improvement initiatives, and reinforcing a culture of quality throughout the organization. The successful candidate will initially oversee core quality operations with the opportunity to build and scale a high‑performing Quality team as the business grows.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Lead and strengthen all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) functions across the nutraceutical contract manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with cGMP, FDA, NSF, and other relevant regulatory and customer requirements.
* Oversee quality systems including document control, CAPA, deviations, change controls, batch record reviews, and audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory readiness.
* Act as the primary quality authority during customer audits, regulatory inspections, and key client interactions.
* Partner cross‑functionally with Production, R&D, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to ensure quality is integrated into all stages of product development and manufacturing.
* Champion a strong quality culture and develop future team capabilities to meet organizational growth.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required**

* Deep understanding of cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations specific to nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturing.
* Proven track record of leading quality systems and regulatory inspections.
* Strong technical expertise in QA/QC processes, risk management, and root‑cause analysis.
* Exceptional communication, leadership, and decision‑making skills.
* Ability to influence, collaborate, and drive high standards across internal teams and external partners.
* Strategic mindset combined with hands‑on execution and problem‑solving abilities.

**Supervisory Responsibility**

Initially leads Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions with the opportunity to expand and structure a broader Quality organization as the company scales.

**Working Conditions**

* Remote‑flexible role with required presence on‑site at U.S. manufacturing facilities.
* Travel required for audits, facility oversight, and key client or regulatory engagements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of Quality leadership experience within the nutraceutical, dietary supplement or pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.
* Demonstrated success managing quality systems in a cGMP environment.
* Experience interacting with regulatory agencies and leading customer audits.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes and quality requirements.

**Success Factors**

* High standards for compliance, accuracy, and operational excellence.
* Ability to set and enforce strong quality expectations throughout the organization.
* Proactive, strategic, and resourceful in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving manufacturing environment.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
**Vice President of Quality**

**Growing Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Business**

**Connecticut**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President of Quality to join a growing, established engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a key leadership appointment, offering the opportunity to shape and develop the quality function, drive operational excellence and embed a proactive culture of quality across the organisation.

The business is continuing to grow and invest in its manufacturing capabilities, making this an important role in ensuring that quality systems, processes and standards evolve in line with its ambitions.

We are particularly interested in hearing from individuals with a background in precision engineering, aerospace or advanced manufacturing, where quality, technical accuracy and process control are fundamental to business performance.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will take overall responsibility for the strategic direction and operational delivery of the Quality function.

A key priority will be to move quality beyond a reactive, inspection-led approach, working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to identify the root causes of issues, implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

You will play a highly visible, cross-functional role, influencing how the business operates and ensuring quality is embedded at every stage of the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Quality function, establishing a clear strategy, measurable objectives and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive a proactive approach to Quality Assurance, focusing on identifying the underlying causes of process and product issues rather than simply addressing the symptoms.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to improve process capability, product consistency and operational performance.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventative action (CAPA) and structured problem-solving initiatives.
* Oversee the Quality Management System, ensuring robust processes, compliance and readiness for internal, external and customer audits.
* Develop and monitor quality KPIs, using data and trend analysis to identify opportunities for improvement and drive accountability.
* Take ownership of supplier quality, working with key suppliers to improve standards, resolve issues and strengthen supply chain performance.
* Partner with Engineering on new product introduction, design changes and manufacturing process improvements.
* Develop, coach and lead a capable quality team, building technical expertise and accountability throughout the function.
* Work closely with the senior leadership team to ensure quality initiatives support wider business objectives, customer satisfaction and continued growth.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a commercially aware and technically credible Quality leader who can operate strategically while remaining close enough to the manufacturing operation to understand where and why issues occur.

**You will ideally bring:**

* Significant senior-level Quality leadership experience within a precision engineering, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or similarly demanding engineering environment.
* A strong background in Quality Assurance, Quality Management Systems and manufacturing process control.
* Proven experience of leading root cause analysis and driving effective, lasting corrective actions across complex manufacturing processes.
* The ability to work cross-functionally, influencing Engineering, Operations, Production and Supply Chain teams to improve quality performance.
* A good understanding of machining, manufacturing processes, materials and engineering specifications.
* Experience with continuous improvement methodologies, statistical process control and quality performance metrics.
* Experience managing customer and supplier quality, audits and regulatory or industry compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop teams and influence at all levels of an organisation.
* A relevant engineering or science degree, alongside substantial Quality Management experience, would be advantageous.

records.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean

postedPay.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean

records.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.
 
 
Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
 
 
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

**Position Success Criteria**

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.
 
 
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
 
 
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.
 
 
Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.
 
 
You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.
 
 
To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.
 
 
We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
