records.title: Director of Transit Products Manufacturing
records.description:
**DIRECTOR OF TRANSIT PRODUCTS MANUFACTURING**

**Position Summary**

Reporting directly to the President, the Director of Transit Products Manufacturing is responsible for providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for all Transit Products manufacturing operations. This role drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, cost optimization, productivity enhancement, quality assurance, and workforce development while supporting the company's growth objectives.

The Director partners closely with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, and Human Resources to align manufacturing capacity and performance with customer demand, financial objectives, and long-term business strategy. The successful candidate will foster a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and employee engagement while delivering exceptional operational results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as management may deem necessary from time to time.*

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide leadership and direction for all Transit Products manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that support company growth, profitability, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction objectives.
* Partner with the Executive Team to establish departmental goals, priorities, budgets, and long-term operational plans.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across manufacturing functions.
* Build and maintain a high-performance culture through coaching, accountability, employee engagement, and leadership development.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Oversee the execution of production plans to meet customer commitments while optimizing labor, equipment, and facility utilization.
* Identify operational constraints, process inefficiencies, and capacity limitations, and lead corrective actions to improve performance.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive data-based decision making and accountability.
* Develop and implement initiatives that improve throughput, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and lower operational costs.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the organization.

**Quality & Safety**

* Maintain a safe working environment and ensure compliance with all company policies, safety regulations, and applicable laws.
* Promote a culture where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are fundamental operating principles.
* Ensure products consistently meet or exceed customer specifications and quality standards.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities to prevent recurring quality and operational issues.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Operations Planning, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to align manufacturing performance with sales forecasts, customer demand, inventory requirements, and financial goals.
* Partner with Engineering to support new product introductions, process improvements, and manufacturability initiatives.
* Work closely with the ERP team to maximize the utilization and effectiveness of ERP systems and related technologies to improve operational visibility and performance.

**People Development**

* Develop, mentor, and build strategies to retain manufacturing leaders and team members.
* Establish clear performance expectations and provide regular coaching, feedback, and development opportunities.
* Support succession planning and organizational development to ensure long-term operational stability and growth.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Participate in daily operational reviews to address production performance, scheduling, delivery commitments, and operational issues.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, improvement initiatives, and strategic plans to executive leadership.
* As a member of the AROW Global leadership team, understand and support the AROW Business System, policies, objectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior management role.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations in a growth-oriented environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team development skills.
* Experience managing budgets, operational metrics, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems; IFS experience preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Transit, Transportation, Bus, Specialty Vehicle, Metal Fabrication, or Industrial Manufacturing environments.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement certification and experience.
* Proven track record of implementing operational excellence initiatives that improve quality, delivery performance, productivity, and profitability.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, communicate, hear, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, and office materials. Periodic business travel will be required on an infrequent basis.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

AROW is an Equal Opportunity and Human Rights Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, provincial, and local employment laws at its U.S. and Canadian locations.

records.title: Plant Director
records.description:
**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Director oversees and manages the overall manufacturing effort of the Rochester Site. He/she is responsible for the profit and loss of the facility through the coordination and management of manufacturing, tooling, human resources, quality assurance, finance, and continuous improvement for the location in support of the overall company objectives. May take part in development of functional strategy. Leads the site's use of AI and automation, in the office and on the shop floor, to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

At Crenlo we invest in our people. Our overall success is contributed to our employees' skills and talents, which have been impactful and essential to the growth of our business. Here, you will get the opportunity to test your knowledge and skills and become a critical player.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directs the overall operations of the facility and all departments within
* Establish sound strategies and tactics aimed towards continued quality, safety, cost improvement and OTD (on-time delivery) of products
* Oversee management review of quality systems and encourages a lean operation by driving continuous improvement, proactive management, and teamwork
* Ensure that facility is properly staffed and trained
* Represents facility to potential customers, clients, and at corporate meetings
* Bears overall responsibility for housekeeping of facility and safety awareness
* Communicates plant financial & operational condition to Corporate
* Manage the operations cost to enhance profitability while staying within legal guidelines and company policies and procedures
* Responsible for the strategy and long-term planning of the operations to ensure continued success in meeting customer expectations
* **Office AI streamlining:** Use AI tools to cut manual work in reporting, daily management prep, shortage and expedite lists, shift reports, and Oracle EBS data cleanup (lead times, BOMs), so leaders spend less time building spreadsheets and more time on the floor
* **Shop floor AI deployment:** Lead pilots and rollout of AI and vision tools on the shop floor. Select AI and automation projects by payback, run pilots, measure results against plant KPIs, and scale what works
* Keep Oracle EBS and shop floor data accurate enough for AI tools to use
* Comply and follow all procedures within the company's IT security policy, including the use of AI tools and protection of customer data and drawings
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong commitment to Crenlo Operating System to drive continuous improvement
 + Strategy Deployment: Break through objectives, action plans, metrics, countermeasures
 + Gemba: shop floor metrics, Gemba walks, interaction with operators to solve problems, action items and follow-up
 + Daily Management: 9:00 meeting every day, what was expected, what did we achieve, what went wrong, what actions are required to restore flow and solve to root
 + KPIs with Countermeasures: Key Performance Indicators. When commitments missed drive countermeasures for root cause corrective actions using data
* Use metrics to drive the business (Data, Paretos, 80/20 approach, visual management)
* Strong understanding and ownership of materials management
 + Capacity Planning
 + Material Flow
 + Inventory Accuracy / Cycle Counting
 + Understanding of how to leverage ERP / MRP
* Attention to detail
* Sense of urgency / bias to action / meets commitments without reminders
* Holds teams accountable (Role clarity, measure and follow-up, rewards and consequences), True owner for every process and metric
* Lead from the front: clearly in charge, strong communications, sets priorities, measures performance
* Doer vs. pure delegator
* Comfortable making decisions
* In depth knowledge of OEM and or component manufacturing with an emphasis on steel processing and cab/auto manufacturing
* Keen knowledge of ISO 9001 and QMS (quality management systems)
* Experienced in using the following software packages: Oracle EBS, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Project, Power BI, AI assistants (e.g., Claude)
* Hands-on user of AI tools in daily work who sets the example for the staff
* Spots repetitive work and turns it into an AI or automation project
* Working knowledge of vision systems, sensors, and robotic and cobot welding
* Brings operators and supervisors along on new technology, positioning AI as a tool that helps them do their jobs
* Ability to build and leverage partnerships, implement change, and manage projects
* Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community
* Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors
* Strong knowledge of global and regional logistics operations and industry
* Strong ability in determining logistics requirements to enable company's business goals and objectives with ability to devise and implement strategy to achieve targets
* Strong financial and analytical ability with proficiency in managing business analytics to determine optimum company footprint
* Proven track record of successful change management accomplishments, implementing and management continuous productivity and cost reduction programs
* Strong and convincing communication skills both verbally and written

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required preferably in Engineering
* Minimum 6-10 years' experience in an operations leadership role with a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role, with direct P&L responsibility, mainly in a manufacturing environment
* Minimum 5 years previous experience managing in a manufacturing environment, preferably in OEM
* Manufacturing management experience should reflect understanding of the impact factory performance has in the areas of delivery, cost, quality, and service
* Previous experience with price structuring and job costing
* Preferred: experience leading an automation, vision, or digital project in a manufacturing plant with measured results
* Or a combination of education, experience and/or training

**WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:**

* Work Hours/Status:
* Travel Requirements:
* Environment:
* Physical Requirements statement(s):

Employees are held accountable for all aspects for the job, which are subject to change at any time. An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. records.title: Strategic Account Director - Manufacturing
records.description:
**Description:**
================

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

**Position Summary:**
=====================

As a Manufacturing Strategic Account Director, you will work with manufacturers and brands of all sizes (with focus on mid-market and enterprise organizations from $70M - $1B+ in annual revenue) to automate the exchange of crucial supply chain data and drive/manage change with their supplier community. The role will focus on working with current Manufacturing subscribers of SPS Relationship Management to expand and grow the partnership through upsell and cross-sell. This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence and presence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others. 
 

This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others.

### **What You'll Do**

* Learn and apply the Relationship Management for Manufacturing go-to-market methodology, adapting as the content evolves.
* Run a value-based sales process and manage a defined territory, from identifying and developing opportunities through close.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for current Manufacturing customers, driving growth through: Additional phases of supplier onboarding across supplier segments, order types, and shipping models Product add-ons such as Visibility Management Maximizing Ongoing Supplier Onboarding where applicable
* Assess each customer's situation, priorities, and stakeholders, then choose and sequence the right sales tools, resources, and SPS partners to move the opportunity forward.
* Manage contractual events such as scope increases and decreases.
* Work closely with SPS account teams to align on customer details and account strategy, share key information openly, and build support for customer success.
* Maintain a rolling 90-day pipeline to meet or exceed your ARR quota.
* Partner with the Strategic Account Executive aligned to your territory as new customers transition to your ownership, and on an ongoing basis as needed.
* Keep customers satisfied by responding promptly and ensuring strong alignment with Customer Success.
Document findings, progress, insights, and pipeline velocity in Salesforce. 

 

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years of quota-carrying sales, **or** some post-secondary education and 9+ years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience managing the full sales cycle: prospecting, building pipeline, handling objections, demonstrating ROI, forecasting accurately, and staying persistent through both short and long cycles.
* Clear, concise, confident communication (verbal, non-verbal, and written), including strong listening skills and the ability to adjust tone to the audience.
* The ability to explain business and technical topics to audiences with varied expertise, and to navigate customer organizations to reach the right stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with product management, support, sales leadership, and senior management.
* Demonstrated integrity, relationship building, and leadership.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SPS Retail/Community or selling SPS System Automation, including selling to the C-suite across functions such as Merchandising, E-Commerce, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, and Finance.
* A track record of building and sustaining executive-level customer relationships.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Salesforce, and a willingness to adopt AI tools such as Claude and CHAMP as they become available.

**Location:** Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid). We are not currently open to candidates who are not local to Minneapolis, MN.

 

### **What We Offer**

**Total annualized on-target compensation: $170,000.** Compensation reflects each employee's experience, performance, and skills. The range for this role considers factors such as education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, and location.

 

Our benefits include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid time off; a 401(k); health and flexible spending accounts; an employee stock purchase plan; and more.

 

### **Our Commitment to Employees**

At SPS, we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward. Our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering outstanding customer solutions, and driving business performance. We do that by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging, and where everyone is accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

 

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

**Commitment to our Employees:**
================================

At SPS we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward, and our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering unparalleled customer solutions, and driving outstanding business performance. We achieve this by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring everyone feels accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

records.title: Senior Director - Customer Experience and Quality
records.description:
Job Overview
 
The Sr. Director, Customer Experience & Quality owns the enterprise-wide direction and execution of Vontier Convenience Retails’ global strategy for customer experience, product quality, and reliability. The role serves as the senior advocate for the customer, this leader establishes global standards, governance, and priorities across global functions. Translating customer feedback, field performance, warranty data, and quality insights into priorities that improve products, services, processes, and support. This leader provides oversight and direction for improving the customer experience and connects Design for Reliability, Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Process Control, field quality, and Customer Service & Support into an integrated end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with commercial, product, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and regional leaders, this position drives rapid issue resolution, systemic corrective action, and continuous improvement across the full product life cycle to increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own, create, and execute the enterprise-wide global customer experience and quality strategy, setting direction, priorities, and standards, and measurable objectives that advance business objectives, strengthens customer loyalty, and continuously improves customer outcomes.
* Establish and govern a disciplined enterprise voice-of-customer process that integrates customer feedback, complaints, service data, warranty trends, and field performance into product and operational priorities.
* Own and direct the global customer issue management and escalation process, ensuring rapid containment, transparent communication, root-cause resolution, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Build trusted relationships with strategic customers and customer quality teams; represent the business in quality reviews, escalations, and long-range improvement planning, with accountability for commitments and customer outcomes
* Implement and further develop the Vontier Reliability System to improve product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience across the installed base.
* Develop and lead a multi-year enterprise deployment plan aligned to the customer experience and quality strategy, including performance targets, resources, processes, governance, and organizational capability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Service, Procurement, and Manufacturing to embed customer requirements and quality controls from concept through end of life.
* Develop, govern, and continuously improve an integrated enterprise performance system covering customer satisfaction, complaint responsiveness, repeat issues, field reliability, warranty, external PPM, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Act as the customer experience and quality advisor to the Vontier Convenience Retail Executive team, using data and customer insights to influence priorities, investment decisions, and accountability.
* Build and lead a high-performing global team and foster a culture of customer focus, collaboration, problem solving, prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to travel up to 30% of working time.

Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
 
Essential
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in quality, engineering, operations, service, or customer facing role within a complex product or manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with accountability for quality performance, customer outcomes, and cross-functional improvement.
* Demonstrated success leading complex customer escalations, complaint resolution, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and executive-level customer communication.
* In-depth knowledge of quality management systems, product reliability, continuous improvement methods, and standards such as ISO 9001.
* Ability to translate voice-of-customer, field, warranty, and quality data into priorities, measurable action plans, and improved customer outcomes.
* Strong enterprise program change, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to align global and cross-functional teams around complex business problems, and sustain accountability across functions and regions
* Executive-level communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills with customers, employees, suppliers, and senior leaders; willingness and ability to travel globally.

Preferable
 

* Advanced technical degree or an MBA is a plus.
* ASQ certification or equivalent (e.g., CMQ/OE, CQE)
* Extensive experience in lean manufacturing; including problem solving and use of kaizen
* Experience working with external partners (suppliers, customers, agencies) to accelerate progress and deliver results.
* Worked directly in or in supporting roles to software development, quality assurance, customer roll-out and software investigation and bug fix resolution.
* Customer facing experience working in roles such as customer service, order management, customer success, application engineering, key account management or sales.

Outcomes and Deliverables
 
Deliverables
 

* Global customer experience and quality strategy with a multi-year deployment plan, clear ownership, resources, governance, capability requirements, and measurable business targets.
* Enterprise voice-of-customer and customer issue management processes, including escalation governance, response standards, root-cause resolution, corrective-action verification, and closed-loop customer communication.
* Integrated customer experience and quality performance system, including dashboards and review routines for customer satisfaction, complaint response, repeat issues, reliability, warranty, external PPM, supplier quality, and cost of poor quality.

Outcomes
 

* A doubling of Net Promoter Scores for “Raving Fans” key customers over a 3 year strategic planning horizon

About Vontier
 
**Vontier (NYSE:** VNT) is a global industrial technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves – delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.

records.title: Director, Dental Furniture Operations
records.description:
At A-dec, we do more than create the highest quality products and services for the dental industry; we strive to deliver a superior employment experience for each of our team members. With an environment that encourages and assists each person in developing to their highest potential, a career at A-dec is incredibly rewarding.

**Overview**
------------

The Director, Dental Furniture Operations provides strategic direction and end-to-end operational oversight for A-dec’s dental furniture value stream at the Newberg campus. The role leads manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning for the value stream and is accountable for delivering the dental furniture business plan, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity growth. The Director partners with product line leadership and functions across Manufacturing and the enterprise to translate product and demand plans into a scalable, high-mix, engineered-to-order operation, while strengthening woodworking capability and continuous improvement.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* End-to-end performance of the Dental Furniture value stream: safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, and inventory against the business plan.
* Dental Furniture purchasing and production and materials planning, including supplier performance, material availability, and inventory levels.
* Capacity, workforce, equipment, and space plans that support Dental Furniture growth and new product introductions.
* Leadership bench strength and succession for all managers and critical roles in assigned areas.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead the managers responsible for manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning. Define the area’s operating system, including standards, tiered performance reviews, and escalation paths, and hold managers accountable for meeting customer and company safety, quality, delivery, and cost standards.
* Develop annual business plans and budgets, including key performance indicators; assess current capacity and capability and establish multi-year plans for workforce, equipment, space, and investment to meet forecasted demand and support growth; prepare business cases for capital and expense needs.
* Set direction for Dental Furniture manufacturing engineering, including process technology, automation, and capital project priorities that improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost and strengthen woodworking capability.
* Own purchasing and production and materials planning for the Dental Furniture line, including supplier selection and performance, material availability, and inventory targets; operate within enterprise purchasing policies, partner with Global Sourcing on commodity strategy and shared suppliers, and represent the value stream in the enterprise SIOP process.
* Partner with product line leadership, Product Development, and Marketing to translate product strategy, roadmap, and pricing into executable operational initiatives and support the transition of new products into production.
* Set annual targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and efficiency; own results and lead monthly operating reviews with managers to set priorities and drive systemic corrective action.
* Lead deployment of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement across assigned areas; set and prioritize the improvement portfolio against the business plan and build a culture of creative problem solving, collaboration, learning, and development.
* Ensure operations within assigned areas comply with company safety, regulatory, and quality policies and applicable environmental requirements; partner with Environmental Health and Safety, Quality, and other functions to address risks and sustain compliance.
* Set performance objectives for direct reports, review results, and hold them accountable for achieving annual business objectives; take appropriate corrective action when needed.
* + Own workforce strategy for assigned areas: with managers, assess capabilities, close skill and staffing gaps, and plan labor against forecasted demand. Develop managers and maintain succession plans for critical roles.
 + Partner with People & Culture to lead organizational design, change management, and employee engagement; promote a respectful, inclusive, and people-focused work environment.
 + Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Operations – Machining & Maintenance on machined-component supply, maintenance service levels, and equipment reliability, and with other Manufacturing leaders on shared capabilities and capital priorities that support Dental Furniture operations.
 + Communicate value-stream priorities, performance, risks, and resource needs to executive leadership, peers, and employees.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to lead managers across manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including high-mix, engineered-to-order production and woodworking or related manufacturing processes.
* Ability to develop and execute business plans, budgets, capacity strategies, and capital priorities aligned with product and business goals.
* Understanding of manufacturing engineering, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Ability to interpret operational and financial data and use performance measures to guide decisions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity.
* Effective communication, relationship-building, and change leadership skills, including the ability to work across product line leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a changing manufacturing environment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations leadership, including at least four years in a senior leadership role.
* Experience leading production planning, materials planning, and purchasing, with accountability for inventory, supplier performance, and SIOP participation.
* Experience leading lean manufacturing and continuous improvement deployment.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and coordinating multiple functions within a manufacturing value stream.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, engineering, operations, or a related field.
* Experience in furniture, woodworking, high-mix, engineered-to-order, or medical device manufacturing.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification.

**Physical Requirements:**

Ability to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise maneuver up to 35 pounds with or without assistance on a routine basis. Must have manual hand dexterity to grasp, operate tools and equipment repetitively. Able to walk, stand, sit, bend, reach, and occasionally kneel, climb steps, and twist throughout an entire shift. Some areas may be exposed to chemicals, noise, vibration and /or dust, and require the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE); such as, but not limited to safety glasses, hearing protection, foot protection, etc.

**Disclaimer**

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not to be construed as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. A-dec reserves the right to assign job duties and days and hours of work based on factors such as workload requirements, staffing levels, and customer demands.

At A-dec, we value our people and show it by prioritizing an inclusive culture, total well-being, and opportunities for learning and career advancement.

**A background check and screen for the illegal use of drugs is required.** 
 
*A-dec is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, A-dec will not discriminate against applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another. \*VEVRAA Federal Contractor”*

*A-dec is interested in qualified candidates authorized to work in the United States for US-based positions. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*

records.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health begin on Day 1.
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

 

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $166,400 to $208,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). Learn more about Hershey’s benefits and all the resources Hershey provides to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial well‑being by visiting the Hershey Digital Employee Experience at www.askHRbenefits.hersheys.com

The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The policy of The Hershey Company is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority/Female/Disabled/Protected Veterans. You may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our online application process as a result of a disability. 
You can request an accommodation via phone or email.To request an accommodation via phone, please call +1 877-804-1794 and leave a voicemail with your contact information. You may also email a request for accommodation to ApplicationHelp@hersheys.com. Please be sure to include “Accommodation Needed” in the subject line. This will ensure that your email is routed to the appropriate contact who will handle your request.

records.title: Production Plant Manager
records.description:
**Position Summary**

The Production Plant Manager is responsible for leading all aspects of manufacturing operations within the paint and coatings production facility. This role ensures the safe, efficient, and cost-effective production of finished goods while maintaining the highest standards of quality, inventory accuracy, environmental compliance, and employee engagement.

The Production Plant Manager oversees daily production activities, manages personnel across manufacturing functions, coordinates production scheduling, maintains raw material and packaging inventories, and partners with Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Sales, Procurement, and Human Resources to meet customer demand and company objectives. This position serves as a key operational leader responsible for driving productivity, continuous improvement initiatives, safety performance, and operational excellence throughout the facility.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Production Operations Management**

* Lead and direct all production floor activities to ensure production schedules are executed safely, efficiently, and accurately.
* Monitor daily production performance and implement corrective actions to achieve forecasted production volumes and company objectives.
* Coordinate manufacturing activities with Batch Makers to ensure products are produced according to approved formulas, specifications, and production schedules.
* Partner with the Canning Line Supervisor to ensure products are packaged, labeled, palletized, and prepared for shipment in accordance with quality standards and customer requirements.
* Monitor filling operations to ensure product quality, cleanliness, and compliance with established manufacturing procedures.
* Ensure efficient utilization of production equipment, tank capacity, labor resources, and plant facilities.
* Oversee production flow to maximize throughput while minimizing downtime, bottlenecks, and manufacturing interruptions.
* Coordinate production changeovers and tank turnovers to facilitate timely batch production and schedule adherence.
* Manage special production requirements, including custom labeling, repackaging, relabeling, and alternate packaging configurations.
* Organize and supervise weekend production activities and special projects as business demands require.
* Respond to operational challenges in real time and implement solutions that minimize production disruptions.

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to production personnel to drive accountability, engagement, and performance.
* Establish clear performance expectations and monitor employee productivity and effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, safety, quality, and continuous improvement throughout the manufacturing organization.
* Resolve employee concerns, conflicts, and operational issues in a professional and timely manner.
* Partner with Human Resources in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, training, and retaining production team members.
* Conduct employee performance evaluations and identify development opportunities for direct and indirect reports.
* Promote employee involvement in problem-solving and process improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained to support operational requirements.

**Inventory and Materials Management**

* Oversee inventory management for raw materials, packaging materials, production supplies, and janitorial supplies across multiple warehouses, storage locations, and bulk tank farms.
* Ensure inventory accuracy through routine cycle counting, reconciliation, and corrective action processes.
* Coordinate material replenishment activities with Procurement and Operations to maintain uninterrupted production schedules.
* Monitor inventory levels and forecast material requirements based on production demand.
* Manage receipt, storage, and utilization of raw materials while ensuring compliance with company procedures and safety standards.
* Coordinate incoming deliveries and storage capacity planning to optimize warehouse utilization.
* Receive bulk raw materials into inventory and ensure completion of all receiving documentation.
* Oversee bulk material offloading operations involving solvents, resins, emulsions, and other chemical raw materials.
* Maintain accountability for tank farm access, fill nozzle controls, and material transfer operations.
* Manage inventory levels of pails, containers, drums, totes, cartons, lids, labels, and other packaging components.
* Investigate inventory variances and implement corrective measures to improve inventory control and accuracy.
* Partner with inventory control personnel to establish and maintain effective inventory counting schedules.

**Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Collaborate with Quality Control personnel to ensure production batches are tested, approved, and released in a timely manner.
* Support troubleshooting efforts involving non-conforming products and manufacturing issues.
* Partner with Quality Control, Laboratory, and R&D teams to identify root causes of quality concerns and implement corrective actions.

* Assist with scale-up activities, formula modifications, and continuous improvement projects designed to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
* Verify production documentation, lot traceability records, and batch records for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are effectively implemented and sustained.

* Collaborate with the Supply Chain Manager to ensure timely distribution and execution of production schedules.
* Generate and review production pick lists and batch documentation prior to release to production personnel.
* Verify production orders, batch tickets, lot numbers, and labeling information for accuracy.
* Ensure manufacturing activities align with customer demand, inventory requirements, and published production schedules.
* Monitor critical material availability and proactively communicate shortages or potential production risks.
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Service, and Supply Chain teams to prioritize production activities and meet customer commitments.
* Provide accurate production status updates and completion forecasts to stakeholders.

**Environmental, Health, and Safety Responsibilities**

* Promote and maintain a safe work environment consistent with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, DOT, local environmental regulations, and other applicable standards.
* Lead safety initiatives, training programs, inspections, investigations, and corrective action efforts.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, transfer, and disposal of hazardous materials and waste streams.
* Manage waste generation activities and coordinate disposal schedules with Quality Control and Operations leadership.
* Conduct routine safety audits and identify opportunities to reduce workplace hazards and risks.
* Ensure employees utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow all safety procedures.

**Maintenance and Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with Maintenance personnel to ensure production equipment remains reliable and operational.
* Assist in prioritizing equipment repairs and preventive maintenance activities.
* Identify process inefficiencies and implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, quality, and cost effectiveness.
* Monitor production metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) including:
 + Production output

 + Labor efficiency
 + Inventory accuracy
 + Waste reduction
 + OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
 + Safety performance
 + Quality metrics
* Lead operational improvement projects utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies as applicable.

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
* Ability to motivate, coach, and hold employees accountable for results.
* Effective conflict resolution and decision-making skills.

**Operational Excellence**

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, inventory control, and operational performance management.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking**

* Exceptional troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and process improvement skills.
* Ability to make timely, data-driven decisions.

**Communication**

* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with employees, management, suppliers, customers, and regulatory agencies.

**Organizational Skills**

* Strong planning, scheduling, and project management capabilities.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage complex operational activities.

**Education and Experience**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Chemical Engineering, Business, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience managing personnel in a production environment.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and quality systems.

**Preferred**

* Experience in paint, coatings, chemical manufacturing, adhesives, or related batch process industries.
* Experience working with hazardous materials and bulk chemical handling operations.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing reporting tools.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

* Frequent walking throughout manufacturing, warehouse, and tank farm areas.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.
* Ability to climb stairs, ladders, and access elevated work areas as needed.
* Exposure to manufacturing environments including noise, dust, chemicals, forklifts, and varying temperatures.
* Must be able to wear required PPE and work safely around industrial equipment and chemical processes.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to modify, assign, or reassign duties and responsibilities as business needs change. Employees may be required to perform other duties as assigned.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Chalk Point Generating Station, situated in Aquasco, Maryland, is a key power generation facility with a total capacity of approximately 1,618 MW. The station features a diverse lineup of nine generating units, including seven gas turbines and two steam turbines. This strategic configuration enhances efficiency and reliability, ensuring the station effectively meets regional energy demands.

**Opportunity Summary**

As the Plant Manager at Chalk Point Generating Station, you will oversee plant operations, maintenance, engineering, safety, environmental compliance, and administration to ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective performance. Responsibilities include leading a union-represented workforce, managing budgets and contractual obligations, maintaining regulatory compliance, and driving operational improvements. Serving as the primary liaison between NAES and the Owner, you will also coordinate with regulatory agencies and community stakeholders to support facility objectives and maintain positive relationships.

***Your scope of responsibility as Plant Manager includes the following primary functions:***

* Direct plant operations, maintenance, safety, administrative, training, chemistry, NERC compliance, and environmental programs to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable performance while meeting operational targets.
* Oversee planned and forced outages, long-term maintenance planning, and asset reliability initiatives, optimizing schedules, resources, and contractor activities to minimize downtime and costs.
* Administer O&M, energy supply, service, and interconnection agreements while overseeing vendor performance and ensuring contractual compliance.
* Establish staffing, training, and qualification programs that support operational requirements, employee development, and facility objectives.
* Promote a strong safety culture through hazard identification, safe work practices, emergency preparedness, employee accountability, and adherence to established safety standards.
* Ensure environmental and regulatory compliance, including permits, landowner agreements, Management of Change (MOC) processes, and timely submission of required reports.
* Manage plant expenditures, operating and capital budgets, forecasting, procurement, and cost controls to achieve financial objectives and meet O&M Agreement requirements.
* Serve as the primary liaison with the Owner, regulatory agencies, and community stakeholders, maintaining positive relationships and supporting community engagement.
* Monitor plant performance, reliability, and operating KPIs while supporting equipment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to improve operational efficiency.
* Lead union-represented and management personnel through performance management, collective bargaining agreement administration, labor relations, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational and workforce effectiveness.
* Maintain reliable attendance and availability to support facility operations and management responsibilities.

* Carry out and complete additional special projects and tasks as needed.

**NAES Safe**

Safety is a core value at NAES, and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to remain mentally alert and work safely at all times. All NAES managers and supervisors have a direct and important role in ensuring that all work is performed in a healthy and safe manner. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each Supervisor’s performance.

**Working Relationships**

The Plant Manager reports to the Operations Director and supervises the managers, technicians, and Plant Administrator. The Plant Manager is the single point of contact between NAES and the Owner on all matters pertaining to the operation, maintenance, and commercial management of the plant.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

Physical requirements include standing for extended periods of time, climbing stairs and ladders, working from elevated platforms and walkways at varying heights, and routinely lifting up to 50 pounds.

Power plant environment that may involve entering confined spaces, crawling through narrow areas, and handling hazardous materials, with exposure to fumes, extreme temperatures, and noise. Work may include high heat near equipment and varying outdoor weather conditions.

Some duties may require the use of protective equipment, which can include hard hats, safety glasses, and eye protection, air masks/respirators, ear protection, chemical suits, flame-resistant clothing (FRC), hot gloves, high-voltage protective gear, and fall protection. Fit testing for respirators may be required. Strict smoking restrictions apply in and around the facility.

**Fitness for Duty**

All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes a post-offer physical examination and drug screening and post-employment random drug screening.

**Work Schedule**

The Plant Manager works a standard Monday to Friday day-shift schedule. This position will require extended hours, flexible shifts, weekends, and holidays as needed to support plant operations and business needs and may also require callout availability. Depending on the position, on-call status may or may not apply.

Some travel may be involved to participate in Manager, Owner, User Group, or other offsite meetings.

**Compensation**

This position offers an annual base salary ranging from $214,000 to $250,000 and includes eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

**Professional Experience and Leadership Competencies**

* A Bachelor of Science degree in engineering or equivalent is desired, providing a strong foundation for understanding the technical aspects of power plant operations and management.

* Previous Plant Manager experience at a gas- or oil-fired power generation facility, or comparable leadership experience overseeing similar industrial operations, is preferred.
* Proven experience supervising technical, supervisory, and union-represented personnel, including collective bargaining agreement administration, grievance resolution, and labor relations.
* Extensive knowledge of power generation operations, independent power producer business practices, commercial agreements, and contractual requirements.
* Demonstrated proficiency in environmental and regulatory compliance, including applicable NERC requirements, operating and capital budgets, financial controls, and contract administration.
* Strong technical understanding of gas and steam turbine operations, outage management, equipment reliability, root cause analysis, and long-term maintenance planning.
* Effective leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage employees, senior management, Owners, regulatory agencies, and external stakeholders.
* Results-oriented approach to problem-solving, workforce development, emergency preparedness, change management, and continuous improvement across operational and financial functions.
* Must possess a valid, unrestricted U.S. driver’s license and ensure it remains in good standing at all times.

**About NAES**

NAES Corporation is a leading provider of operations, maintenance, and engineering services for energy facilities. We serve clients across the power generation, oil and gas, and renewable energy sectors throughout North America and internationally, supporting the full life cycle of power generation and other industrial facilities.

NAES is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on merit and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, USERRA-protected status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

#### **Experience**

Preferred

* A Bachelor of Science degree in engineering or equivalent is desired, providing a strong foundation for understanding the technical aspects of power plant operations and management.
* Previous Plant Manager experience at a gas- or oil-fired power generation facility, or comparable leadership experience overseeing similar industrial operations, is preferred.
* Proven experience supervising technical, supervisory, and union-represented personnel, including collective bargaining agreement administration, grievance resolution, and labor relations.
* Extensive knowledge of power generation operations, independent power producer business practices, commercial agreements, and contractual requirements.
* Demonstrated proficiency in environmental and regulatory compliance, including applicable NERC requirements, operating and capital budgets, financial controls, and contract administration.
* Strong technical understanding of gas and steam turbine operations, outage management, equipment reliability, root cause analysis, and long-term maintenance planning.
* Effective leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage employees, senior management, Owners, regulatory agencies, and external stakeholders.
* Results-oriented approach to problem-solving, workforce development, emergency preparedness, change management, and continuous improvement across operational and financial functions.

#### **Education**

* Bachelors or better in Engineering or related field

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

* Driver's License

**FACILITY DIRECTOR**

**Vista Specialty Hospital**

**Facility Director Director Job Summary:**

To plan, organize, supervise, coordinate and control the activities of the plant operations and maintenance functions which are necessary in maintaining the physical structures, HVAC, mechanical, electrical systems, utilities and grounds of this hospital in an operative and safe working condition. Maintains performance improvement activities within the department and participates in CQI activities. Assures competency of all personnel. Assists in formulating the budget. Maintains efficient and effective department operation while requiring compliance with all JCAHO, state, federal and local regulatory laws, standards and protocols.

**Education:** High School diploma or equivalent. Associate degree or equivalent from two-year college or technical school preferred. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may substitute for education requirements.

**Licenses/Certification:** Trade certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC or similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum three years’ related experience in a healthcare setting with some administrative and supervisory responsibility. Considerable experience in maintenance, plant operation and construction.

Safety Sensitive-Designated Position

records.title: EW Operations Engineering Director
records.description:
**Job Description** 
We are seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished EW Operations Engineering Director with strong Hardware, Systems, and RF design experience, to bridge the gap between advance systems development and factory production. This executive-level role requires a deeply experienced leader who understands product requirements and performance to oversee the complete Life Cycle Management (LCM) of complex hardware ensuring that highly sophisticated Digital and RF Designs seamlessly transition from design environments into full scale production.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and acts as the ultimate authority and liaison between Systems/Hardware Designs engineering and Manufacturing Operations. You will champion “Left Shift” engineering philosophies-refining, shaping, and validating hardware configurations long before they reach the factory floor to optimize, yield, efficiency, and electrical and mechanical compliances
 
•**Key Responsibilities**
 
•**Strategic Operations and Factory Leadership**
 
•Production Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end process governing how critical hardware is moved, staged, and executes across factories of record.
 
•Factory of record integration: Maintain comprehensive understanding of the People, Build, Equipment limitations, Operational Rules and technical boundaries to align design tolerances with factory capabilities.
 
•Operational Compliance: Author, Develop, and Maintain the Manufacturing Design Rules Documents in collaboration with the process engineers and subject matter experts (SME). Establish robust mitigation strategies for Non-compliant or ‘Red” technical requirements
 
•Technology Insertion: Evaluate, introduce, and integrate new manufacturing and test technologies and evolving factory capabilities to continually improve product lines.
 
•**Cross-Functional Engineering Liaison & Governance**
 
•Design-to-Production: Acts as the strategic liaison between Systems/HW Design and Operations “Enforcing” high standard and quality for manufacturing readiness and knowing precisely when to push back on design elements that challenge manufacturability
 
•Change Control & Audits : Represent Operations by attending and activity presenting Manufacturability requirements at the Engineering Leadership CARBs (Change/Configuration Action review Boards)
 
•Compliance & Technical Reviews: Demonstrate, Organize and Execute Systems/HW programs reviews including CCB (Change Control Boards) and PRB (Program Review Boards) to mitigate electrical compliance
 
•Left Shift & Process Optimization: Drive early-Stage engagement through the P2L/NPI processes to shape, refine and mature hardware layouts prior to factory entry
 
•**Test Engineering Strategy and Operations Engagement**
 
•Production test architecture: Oversee and understand the vision and long-term production test strategy, ensuring test development frameworks are fully integrated with operations,
 
•Design-for-Test (DFT): Partner directly with Hardware Design and test development engineering to enforce strict Production Test requirements and enforcing the Operations Test Rules 
 
 
 
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

•Education: Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Operations or a closely related technical discipline

•Experience Level: Minimum of 20+ years of dedicated System/HW designs and Engineering/Operational Leadership with complex digital and high-frequency RF hardware domain

•Domain Expertise: Technical proficiency of electronic warfare (EW) systems. Including an expert-level understanding of how the hardware behaves internally and externally under operating conditions. Understanding critical System Tradeoffs in electrical performance.

•LCM Mastery: Documented success reshaping the Life-Cycle Management (LCM) paradigms, establishing “Left-Shift” framework and streamlining product handoffs to manufacturing

•Governance: Extensive background running rigorous technical reviews, electrical compliance boards, CCBs and PRBs

 
 
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

•Cross Discipline Mobilization: Lead, Mentor and rally multi-discipline, cross-functional engineering and operational teams to achieve swift pragmatic solutions (Driving to high confidence \*80% rule)

Trend Analysis & Optimizations: Partner with the program engineering groups to monitor production trends, identify anomalies, isolate hardware failure modes, and making data driven discissions )
 
 
**Pay Information**
 
Full-Time Salary Range: $173023 - $294137
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
 
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

records.title: Senior Manager, Weatherization Quality & Technical Services

postedPay.title: Senior Manager, Weatherization Quality & Technical Services

records.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

The mission of the Colorado Energy Office (CEO) is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and consumer energy costs by advancing clean energy, energy efficiency, and zero emission vehicles to benefit all Coloradans. We do this by developing and implementing highly impactful policies and programs, establishing Colorado as a leading state for climate action. The Colorado Energy Office is a great place to work, with collaborative and talented employees who are passionate about our mission and a hybrid atmosphere. Employees report high satisfaction with their work, their colleagues and manager, and CEO leadership. Join us!

 
 

Reducing greenhouse gas pollution and advancing zero emission vehicles, energy efficiency and clean energy are essential to preserving and protecting Colorado’s way of life. These actions defend the health of our communities and natural environment, provide access to lower cost clean energy resources for rural and urban areas, increase investment and economic growth opportunities, and expand clean energy jobs. As part of our mission we serve the people of Colorado with programs focusing on weatherization, energy efficiency, and electric vehicles and a regulatory and legislative agenda to promote the interests of all Coloradans.

 
 

***We are committed to increasing the diversity of our staff and providing culturally responsive programs and services. Therefore, we encourage responses from people of all backgrounds and abilities.***

**Description of Job**
----------------------

* **This is a hybrid position. Hybrid positions are required to be present at the office location for a minimum of two days per work week during the first 90 days, and minimum one to two days a week after that, or as directed by office leadership.**

CEO’s Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP), helps qualified Coloradans save money, increase comfort, and better their homes and environment through proven energy conservation solutions.These solutions include LED light bulbs, high efficiency furnaces and refrigerators, building shell insulation, and rooftop solar arrays, among others.

 
 

CEO is hiring for a visionary Senior Manager, Weatherization Quality & Technical Services to join the WAP team. You will serve as a strategic leader, bridging advanced building science with organizational excellence. This role is pivotal in shaping how we deliver sustainable energy solutions to diverse communities across Colorado, turning technical compliance into a platform for continuous improvement and innovation.

The WAP network spans all 64 Colorado counties, delivering critical energy efficiency and clean energy solutions to diverse populations through a network of six subgrantee agencies. As the Senior Manager, you will step into a high-impact, supervisory role overseeing a team of technical experts located around the state who serve as the definitive authority on residential building science, ensuring weatherization work meets performance standards through on-site inspections, detailed reporting, and training, while also acting as an internal and network consultant to streamline operations, drive process improvement, and ensure program delivery is transparent and visible.

 
 

In this senior-level manager capacity, you will blend advanced building science knowledge with administrative leadership and process optimization.

WAP Specific Duties and Responsibilities

* Lead the Quality Management team, which includes Technical & QCI Quality Management staff in completing all necessary BPI certified Quality Assurance Inspections (typically 50-75/yr) and Quality Control visits (typically 20-30/yr) across Colorado to meet all federal and state statutory and programmatic requirements
* Balance the team’s core focus (QA, QC, & training) with opportunities for ongoing innovation.
* Drive strategic quality management through Quality Control and Assurance (QC & QA), transforming federal guidelines into accessible, actionable insights that empower our subgrantee network
* Cultivate a high-performing team by providing mentorship and leadership that fosters a collaborative, inclusive environment where technical experts can thrive and innovate
* Partner with other CEO WAP teams to integrate quality management operational outcomes with targeted training to drive continuous, lasting enhancements across the program
* Lead the QM team in partnering with other CEO WAP teams to develop and deliver targeted, hands-on guidance to local subgrantee organizations undergoing leadership shifts or performance remediation, ensuring full alignment with state and federal guidelines, state program implementation strategies, and complementary clean energy initiatives
* Champion Operational Excellence by collaborating cross-functionally with other CEO WAP teams to identify bottlenecks, modernize our workflows, and scale our program’s reach
* Provide immediate support to subgrantees to address critical safety hazards detected during site evaluations or staff reviews, escalating severe concerns to WAP Director when subgrantee remediation or corrective action is warranted
* Work with the rest of the WAP team on QM production metrics from subgrantee agencies, auditing subgrantee performance for integrity and collaborating cross-functionally to report key outcomes to program leadership, federal partners, state administrators, and legislative bodies
* Influence Program Strategy by serving as a key advisor in creating WAP policy, translating real-world QM data into meaningful policy updates that increase program equity and effectiveness
* Modernize Tooling by leading the integration and management of platforms like monday.com to create transparent, streamlined project tracking systems and program delivery improvements.
* Participate in national and regional WAP events hosted by national associations to learn from and elevate the work of Colorado WAP

General Duties and Responsibilities

* Adhere to all technical and health and safety policies and procedures in the planning and execution of activities
* Maintain positive working relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders including WAP subgrantee agency staff, CEO Ops and Finance team, Federal Department of Energy partners, among others
* Abide by office policies and procedures in a manner that ensures fiscal responsibility and promotes efficient, effective, and elegant government.
* Use application software (i.e. word processing, spreadsheet, database, project management software, etc.) to prepare correspondence, plans, reports, schedules, and other documents
* Assist other CEO departments in carrying out unit and office wide priorities.
* Perform other duties as requested and required

**Supplemental Information**
