records.title: Director, Loyalty Strategy & Operations
records.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the role**
----------------------------

 

The Director of Loyalty Strategy & Operations will own Brand Expedia's loyalty strategy and operational delivery globally, while also leading the cross-brand element of loyalty across Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo.

 

Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Growth & Loyalty for Brand Expedia, this role is best suited to a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of loyalty program best practices, program economics, and operational scaling.

 

You will bring a data-driven approach and an analytical mindset to dive into insights, listen to travelers, and uncover growth opportunities that ladder up to our broader organizational goals.

 

Close collaboration with Brand Expedia leadership and cross-brand partners is essential to align loyalty strategy with brand-specific goals and key performance indicators. This role regularly interfaces with executive (SVP+ and C-level) leadership as well as cross-functional partners across all levels, requiring authentic relationship-building and strong stakeholder alignment.

 

Additionally, this role proactively identifies opportunities to improve traveler journeys, elevate engagement, and strengthen brand loyalty through continuous enhancements to current offerings, prioritizing simplicity, operational rigor, and traveler comprehension.

 

Finally, this role is external-facing and engages with key strategic partners and third-party entities, fostering high-impact relationships to elevate the Brand Expedia traveler experience.

 

**In this role, you will:**

 

**Strategic Vision & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Own the vision and develop strategies to grow and strengthen customer relationships, repeat bookings, and long-term stickiness through Brand Expedia loyalty and customer growth initiatives.
* Drive a comprehensive loyalty and customer growth agenda, aligning program value propositions with short-term incentives, lifecycle touchpoints, and personalized member experiences.
* Manage and strengthen cross-functional relationships across Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo to ensure tight alignment between loyalty operations and brand strategy.
* Act as an energetic advocate for loyalty at every level, connecting program strategy back to the company's broader business objectives and ensuring loyalty has a clear voice across the organization.
* Flex effortlessly between high-level strategic vision and detailed operational execution, knowing when to dive into mechanics and when to empower your team.
* Utilize market research, customer insights, competitor intelligence, and behavioral data analytics to identify high-potential customer segments and personalize member engagement.
* Design, implement, and optimize loyalty offerings and operational workflows to ensure they deliver tangible customer value and achieve business targets.
* Serve as the dedicated voice of the traveler, partnering closely with brand marketing, product development, and member experience teams.
* Balance agile, short-term experimentation (such as rapid test-and-learn initiatives) with scalable, long-term programmatic frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with Loyalty Performance, Finance, and Analytics teams on program economics, business casing, and measurement, while partnering with Product, Technology, and Experience Design (XD) to deliver seamless end-to-end traveler journeys.
Coordinate with CRM, Integrated Marketing, Research & Insights, and commercial teams to drive cohesive execution across channels. 

 

**Team Leadership & Operational Stewardship**

* Lead, inspire, and grow a high-performing organization of 6 team members, including direct management of 3 Senior Managers, cultivating an inclusive, innovative environment with a "Go Get What's Next" mindset.
* Guide team operations, resource allocation, and project roadmaps to ensure seamless delivery across all strategic loyalty streams.
* Empower team members to move quickly, resolve roadblocks independently, and drive measurable outcomes with clarity.
* Unlock each team member's full potential, supporting individualized development paths and career progression.
* Build trust, positive momentum, and mutual accountability across the team and with executive stakeholders.
Balance workloads effectively so all team members are fully engaged and given meaningful opportunities to stretch their leadership capabilities. 

 

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in loyalty strategy, customer lifecycle marketing, or commercial growth, with a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of demonstrated people leadership experience, with proven success managing people leaders (e.g. Senior Managers) and developing high-performing teams.
* Proven track record leading large-scale, global loyalty programs and complex operational workstreams that deliver exceptional business outcomes.
* Deep domain expertise in modern loyalty strategies, customer retention, motivational mechanics, and incentive design.
* Strong business acumen and analytical capability to interpret complex data, model program economics, and make decisive, value-generating decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across diverse groups, including Product, Technology, Analytics, Finance, Supply, Brand Marketing, and Customer Operations.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with a proven ability to influence, socialize recommendations, and drive alignment at all leadership levels.
* Passion for designing delightful customer experiences and driving customer retention through customer-centric, data-grounded approaches.
* Thrives in a dynamic, collaborative environment, managing multiple priorities with sound judgment, adaptability, and high attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and modern collaboration tools.
* Experience with Tableau or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.
Proactive curiosity and ability to leverage modern AI tools to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and elevate team efficiency. 

 
The total cash range for this position in New York is $224,000.00 to $313,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $358,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.
The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. 
 

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

 

**Benefits and perks**

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .

 

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

 

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

 

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

 

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

records.description:
**About NYC Health + Hospitals**
--------------------------------

 

NYC Health + Hospitals is the largest public health care system in the United States. We provide essential outpatient, inpatient and home-based services to more than one million New Yorkers every year across the city’s five boroughs. Our large health system consists of ambulatory centers, acute care centers, post-acute care/long-term care, rehabilitation programs, Home Care, and Correctional Health Services. Our diverse workforce is uniquely focused on empowering New Yorkers.

At NYC Health + Hospitals, our mission is to deliver high quality care health services, without exception. Every employee takes a person-centered approach that exemplifies the ICARE values (Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence) through empathic communication and partnerships between all persons.

**Work Shifts**
---------------

 

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

 

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Strategic Planning

* Lead the indirect procurement function by developing and executing a comprehensive strategy to optimize spend across diverse non-clinical categories
* Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align procurement strategies with organizational goals and operational priorities
* Utilize data analytics and market intelligence to identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier consolidation
* Develop operating procedures, internal policies, and training guides to support consistent procurement practices
* Partner with internal stakeholders to create scopes of work, request for proposals, and other solicitation documents

2. Operational Performance

* Oversee contracting, monitor contract compliance, and manage vendor relationships to ensure optimal pricing, service levels, and risk mitigation
* Drive cost-savings initiatives while maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, organizational policies, and industry standards
* Manage capital procurement activities in coordination with internal and external partners throughout planning, budgeting, project management, and transactional phases
* Monitor supplier performance, manage risks, and resolve issues promptly to maintain uninterrupted service and supply
* Develop and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to savings, supplier performance, and process efficiency
* Prioritize procurement activities to meet end-user deadlines and expectations
* Develop and deliver executive briefings to senior leadership, providing insights on supply chain performance, risk mitigation, and strategic opportunities
* Perform related duties as required to support departmental and organizational objectives

3. Staff Development

* Train and lead a high-performing procurement team focused on operational excellence and professional growth
* Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages continuous learning and improvement
* Implement training programs to enhance team skills in strategic sourcing, contract management, and vendor relations
* Promote effective communication and engagement across all levels of the organization

4. Financial Management

* Lead spend reduction initiatives and ensure effective financial management of indirect procurement budgets
* Collaborate with finance and project teams to ensure accurate budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting
* Conduct procurement audits and risk assessments to maintain fiscal discipline and compliance
* Utilize financial data to track savings realization, cost avoidance, and return on investment

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

 

1. Baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Computer Science,
 
Management or other related discipline from an accredited college or university; and six (6) years of satisfactory,
 
full-time paid responsible experience in information processing, program management, systems development or
 
related activity in a large governmental agency, hospital or health care facility, or hospital-related business firm,
 
three (3) years of which must have been in a managerial capacity; or
 
2. Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in disciplines, as listed in “1” above, and five (5) years of
 
experience, as described in #2 above, one (1) year of which must have been in a managerial capacity; or
 
3. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Department Preferences**
--------------------------

* Indirect and Non-Clinical Spend Categories
* Strategic Sourcing
* Contract Negotiation
* Vendor Management

**Benefits**
------------

 

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

**How To Apply**
----------------

 

If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

records.description:
**About K12 Coalition**

K12 Coalition provides products and services that help K-12 schools and teachers achieve transformational learning outcomes. We tackle many of today’s toughest education obstacles, including teacher certification, test preparation, professional learning, curriculum, consulting, and strategic planning. K12 Coalition came together when educators with deep experience as teachers, school leaders, and high-level district administrators observed a genuine need for something better. Our divisions include iteach, Passage Preparation, Professional Development Institute, Teaching Channel, Lavinia Group, and Keys to Literacy.

 

**About Lavinia Group**

Lavinia Group is dedicated to driving meaningful academic improvements in K-12 education through instructional coaching, professional learning, high-quality curriculum, strategic planning, and summer school support that enhances educator effectiveness and strengthens student outcomes.

 

With deep expertise in school leadership, curriculum implementation, and instructional best practices, Lavinia Group delivers tailored, research-based solutions to meet the evolving needs of our partners. Guided by a commitment to equity, instructional excellence, and long-term capacity building, we work alongside educators and district leaders through hands-on coaching, immersive training, and collaborative partnerships. Our mission is to help schools achieve transformational learning outcomes that endure beyond our direct support.

 

**Employment Type:**

* Full-Time
* Exempt
* Salaried

 

**Location:** Remote, available from anywhere within the U.S.

 

**The Opportunity**

Lavinia Group, a division of K12 Coalition, is seeking an Operations Director, Curriculum & School Support to build and lead the systems that bring our curriculum and professional learning services to schools. The largest focus of this role is managing the full operational lifecycle of our print curriculum, from demand forecasting and inventory planning to production, fulfillment, and direct customer support. This role also leads operational planning for digital curriculum, professional learning, and consultant staffing outside of our RISE summer learning program.

 

This is an opportunity to help shape how a newly structured operations team works together. Partnering with the Managing Director, Operations and fellow operations leaders, you will help establish clear responsibilities, shared processes, and scalable systems across Lavinia Group while leading execution within your own portfolio. You will turn product and service priorities into practical plans, use technology and AI to improve workflows, and build the operational foundation for new offerings and continued growth.

 

The Operations Director, Curriculum & School Support reports to the Managing Director, Operations and directly manages a Senior Associate, Operations. This role is ideal for an operations leader who enjoys building structure, solving complex delivery challenges, and staying closely involved in day-to-day execution.

 

**What You’ll Do**

Print Curriculum & Fulfillment Operations

* Lead the full print curriculum workflow, including demand forecasting, inventory planning, production schedules, ordering, and fulfillment.
* Partner with Sales and Curriculum teams to translate sales projections, partner needs, and product timelines into purchasing and production plans.
* Manage print vendors, book vendors, and fulfillment partners, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and issue resolution against quality, cost, and delivery expectations.
* Monitor inventory and fulfillment costs, anticipating shortages, excess stock, and delivery risks and adjusting plans as needs change.
* Provide direct customer support for curriculum orders and delivery questions, coordinating timely resolution of fulfillment issues and keeping partners informed.

Operational Systems & Product Implementation

* Build and improve the systems, workflows, and project plans that support curriculum and professional learning development, implementation, and delivery.
* Partner with Curriculum, Product, and Technology teams to define operational requirements for digital curriculum platforms and coordinate improvements that support users and internal teams.
* Establish consistent partner onboarding processes and coordinate operational readiness for product launches, updates, and retirements.
* Use technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual work, improve visibility, and create more reliable, scalable workflows.
* Partner with fellow operations leaders to establish shared practices, clarify team handoffs, and resolve dependencies across Lavinia Group.

Professional Learning & Consultant Staffing

* Lead operational planning for partner-facing professional learning and coaching services, aligning schedules, staffing, resources, and delivery requirements.
* Develop and maintain staffing and capacity plans, partnering with academic and service leaders to forecast facilitator, consultant, and content-development needs.
* Manage consultant staffing and utilization in Hub Planner, maintaining accurate assignments and availability and addressing capacity gaps with relevant leaders.
* Manage workflows for custom professional learning requests, pricing, and approvals in partnership with academic and business leaders.
* Establish operational delivery standards and monitor utilization, delivery days, and partner feedback to identify and implement improvements.

Budget & Performance Management

* Build and manage curriculum, product, and professional learning operating budgets in partnership with the Managing Director, Operations and relevant business leaders.
* Monitor spending, delivery costs, and budget performance, recommending adjustments that align resources with demand and organizational priorities.
* Maintain reporting that gives leaders clear visibility into inventory, fulfillment, staffing capacity, and operational performance.
* Coordinate with finance and sales operations colleagues to ensure accurate information and clear handoffs for invoicing, contracting, and vendor onboarding.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop the Senior Associate, Operations, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback, delegate work effectively, and support professional growth while maintaining accountability for team deliverables.

Other Duties

* Support the team with additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to help meet evolving organizational goals and objectives.

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in operations, product operations, supply chain, or a related field, including managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Direct experience managing operations for physical products sold to customers, including demand forecasting, inventory planning, production or purchasing coordination, and fulfillment.
* Experience managing vendors and fulfillment partners, including monitoring costs, quality, and delivery performance and resolving customer issues.
* Demonstrated success building scalable operational systems and workflows, including defining operational requirements, partnering across teams to implement improvements, and using AI-enabled tools and automation to reduce manual work.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing operational data, and developing staffing, capacity, or resource plans.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports, including setting priorities, delegating work, and providing performance feedback.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, for forecasting, reporting, data analysis, and operational decision-making, along with experience using project management or workflow tools.
* Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments.
* Experience in K–12 education, curriculum publishing, or professional learning is preferred but not required.

**How We Work at K12 Coalition**

Our work is grounded in five Core Competencies that guide how we collaborate, support others, and move work forward: Accountability, Adaptability, Collaboration, Customer Service Orientation, and Initiative.

* **Accountability:** Following through on work, owning commitments, and communicating progress or challenges along the way.
* **Adaptability:** Navigating change with flexibility and focus as priorities, information, or needs shift.
* **Collaboration:** Working together across roles and perspectives to achieve shared goals.
* **Customer Service Orientation:** Meeting the needs of internal and external partners with clarity, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* **Initiative:** Taking action without waiting to be asked and looking for ways to improve systems, processes, or experiences.

 

**Compensation Philosophy**

As part of our commitment to maintaining fair and consistent compensation practices, new hires are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the band minimum and midpoint, based on their qualifications, location, internal alignment, and the budgeted amount for the role.

 

**Why Work with Us**

We believe in supporting the whole employee by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet diverse needs. Our full-time employee benefits include flexible time off, paid parental leave, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a 401(k) with company matching. We are committed to fostering a work environment that promotes both personal and professional well-being.

 

**Our Typical Selection Process**

Our selection process typically includes an online application, a short phone interview, a hiring manager interview, a candidate exercise, and a final interview.

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

K12 Coalition is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need assistance or accommodation during the interview process due to a disability, please email us at recruitingteam@k12coalition.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

 

**Protecting Your Job Search**

K12 Coalition is committed to a transparent and secure recruitment process. Please keep the following in mind as you explore opportunities with us:

* **Official communication:** All recruitment-related communication will come from an @k12coalition.com email address. We do not use messaging platforms for recruiting.
* **Application process:** We do not send unsolicited job offers. All open positions are listed on our official Careers Page, and any offer follows a formal interview process.
* **No upfront payments:** We will never ask candidates to pay fees of any kind during the hiring process, including for training materials, background checks, or equipment.

 

If you receive any communication that does not align with the above, please report it to recruitingteam@k12coalition.com.

records.title: Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Develop leaders and employees through coaching, succession planning, workforce development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Utilize KPIs and operational metrics to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive sustainable business improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar senior manufacturing leader.
* Proven success managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve and sustain performance targets in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and operational expenses.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Experience supporting or maintaining IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified Manufacturing Manager (CMfgM), PMP certification, or similar professional credentials.
* Master's degree in a related discipline.

Why you'll want to join our team:

* Lead a critical manufacturing operation with broad operational responsibility.
* Make a meaningful impact on plant performance, customer satisfaction, and company growth.
* Partner with an experienced leadership team in a collaborative environment.
* Drive operational excellence and shape the future of the facility.
* Develop and mentor the next generation of manufacturing leaders.
* Influence strategic initiatives, capital investments, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive benefits and salary package being offered for this role.

This position is based on-site in Warren, MI and requires a strong presence on the production floor. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, supplier visits, training, and corporate initiatives.

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Overview**
Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger
  
  
The Quality Director plays a pivotal role in leading and strengthening operational quality and quality compliance within a large-scale contract manufacturing facility. Responsible for both Product Quality and Quality Management System (QMS) compliance, this leader ensures quality operations within the manufacturing environment consistently meet customer, regulatory, and business expectations.
  
  
This individual combines strategic vision with hands-on operational quality leadership, ensuring Resonetics delivers world-class quality in a fast-paced, highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The role demands proven experience within manufacturing operations, deep expertise in ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820, mastery of advanced quality assurance techniques, and the ability to align and elevate quality performance across multiple value streams.
  
  
Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Quality Leadership**

* Own and lead all aspects of manufacturing quality performance, ensuring operational processes deliver consistent, compliant, and high-yield outcomes.
* Partner closely with Operations leadership to embed quality into daily production activities and drive problem-solving directly on the manufacturing floor.
* Implement and oversee statistical process control (SPC), process capability, and other data-driven tools to ensure process stability and continuous improvement.
* Monitor and manage critical quality metrics, taking immediate action to address gaps and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Oversee validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ) for manufacturing processes and equipment, ensuring robustness and compliance.
* Provide quality leadership in New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring robust process validation, risk management, and seamless transition from development into full-scale manufacturing.

**Quality Systems & Compliance**

* Ensure the ISO-certified QMS is operationally effective within manufacturing sites and continuously improved to support business growth.
* Maintain full compliance with ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, and other relevant standards through proactive system management and audit readiness.

**Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving**

* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for complex production challenges.
* Drive Lean and Six Sigma initiatives that enhance manufacturing efficiency while strengthening compliance and product quality.
* Share best practices across sites to ensure standardization and scalability of quality improvements.

**Customer & Supplier Interface**

* Serve as the primary quality leader for high-visibility customers, ensuring confidence in Resonetics’ ability to deliver consistently high-quality products.
* Lead the supplier quality program, ensuring raw materials and outsourced processes meet stringent requirements to support operational excellence.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build and mentor a strong quality team embedded within the manufacturing organization.
* Provide training in advanced quality tools (Gage R&R, SPC, pFMEA, Risk Analysis, Validation, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA) to elevate operational capability.
* Foster a culture of quality culture and ownership on the production floor, engaging all levels of the workforce.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years’ experience in a Medical Device Quality Management role.
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Demonstrated background in an ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 quality management system.
* Strong communication skills (verbal and writing)
* BS degree in a management or engineering discipline
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits

**Preferred Qualifications**

At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.

* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.

records.title: Vice President, Quality
records.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.
  
  
The Vice President of Quality is an enterprise leadership role accountable for enterprise quality performance, not just quality systems. This leader will define and execute nVent’s quality strategy across the full value chain, with direct accountability for improving customer escapes, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, supplier quality performance, warranty performance, product reliability, on-time-to-customer impact, and launch quality. The role will shift quality from a primarily compliance- and governance-centered function to a performance-driving enterprise capability that improves customer outcomes, operational execution, and business growth.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Supply Chain Officer, the Vice President Quality will serve as the senior-most quality leader for nVent, setting the vision, operating model, performance expectations, capabilities, and accountability mechanisms required to scale quality as nVent grows. This leader will partner closely with segment presidents, operations, engineering, product management, sourcing and procurement, digital, commercial, legal, and finance leaders to embed quality into business decision-making and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, reliability, warranty, launch readiness, supplier performance, operational quality, and quality-related business risk.
  
  
**What You Will Experience In This Position**
Enterprise Quality Performance and Accountability
  
  

* Own enterprise quality performance outcomes, including customer escapes, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, supplier quality, warranty, reliability, launch quality, and the impact of quality issues on on-time-to-customer performance.
* Translate quality strategy into measurable business results, ensuring quality priorities are directly connected to customer experience, operational performance, growth, profitability, and risk reduction.
* Establish clear enterprise, segment, region, business unit, and site-level accountability for the quality metrics that matter most to customers and the business.
* Lead operating reviews that move beyond reporting activity to identifying performance gaps, driving root cause ownership, and sustaining measurable improvement.

New Product Quality and Launch Excellence
  
  

* Elevate new product quality as a core enterprise capability, ensuring quality is designed into high-growth platforms, strategic programs, and critical infrastructure solutions from concept through launch and field performance.
* Partner with engineering, product management, operations, and commercial leaders to strengthen quality planning, design validation, process validation, risk assessment, reliability requirements, and launch readiness across major programs such as Saturn, Avatar, Data Solutions growth initiatives, and other strategic launches.
* Ensure robust NPI quality gates, readiness reviews, and escalation criteria are in place to prevent launch defects, customer escapes, warranty exposure, and reliability issues.
* Build feedback loops from field performance, warranty, customer quality, and manufacturing quality data into product development and launch processes.

Digital Quality, Analytics, and Enterprise Quality Intelligence
  
  

* Lead the evolution of digital quality as an enterprise capability, including predictive quality, AI-enabled risk detection, manufacturing quality analytics, digital traceability, and enterprise quality intelligence.
* Partner with Digital and Integrated Supply Chain leaders to modernize eQMS capabilities, automate quality workflows, strengthen data integrity, and establish a single source of truth for enterprise quality performance.
* Use advanced analytics to identify leading indicators of quality risk across product design, suppliers, manufacturing processes, field performance, warranty, and customer experience.
* Move the organization from lagging quality reporting to predictive and preventive insights that enable faster decisions, better prioritization, and measurable performance improvement.

Quality Management Systems, Compliance, and Standards
  
  

* Lead the modernization, standardization, and continuous improvement of nVent’s Quality Management System, ensuring systems and standards enable performance improvement rather than becoming ends in themselves.
* Ensure readiness and sustained compliance with applicable quality and regulatory standards, including ISO 9001 and other business-relevant standards such as ISO 14001, AS9100, customer-specific requirements, and regional regulatory expectations.
* Strengthen management review, internal audit, external audit, and corrective and preventive action processes to ensure systemic issues are identified, resolved, and prevented from recurring.
* Partner with legal, compliance, engineering, operations, and commercial teams to manage quality-related risk and ensure quality commitments are understood, objective, and executable.

Customer, Supplier, and Operational Quality
  
  

* Build customer quality capability that improves responsiveness, transparency, containment, corrective action effectiveness, customer confidence, and reduction of repeat escapes.
* Advance supplier quality strategy, qualification, audit discipline, scorecards, supplier development, and escalation processes to improve supplier performance and protect customer commitments.
* Embed quality into manufacturing and operational processes with a focus on defect prevention, first-pass yield, process capability, reliability, error proofing, and flow to customer.
* Use customer feedback, warranty data, supplier performance, manufacturing quality, field performance, and operational metrics to prioritize systemic improvement opportunities.

Leadership, Talent, and Quality Culture
  
  

* Champion a quality-first culture where leaders model prevention-based decision-making and teams are empowered to stop, escalate, and resolve issues before they reach the customer.
* Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing quality leadership team with clear accountability, succession depth, and strong capability across enterprise, segment, regional, and site quality roles.
* Lead through influence in a matrixed environment, balancing enterprise standards with business-specific execution needs and measurable performance outcomes.
* Model executive leadership behaviors, including strategic thinking, courageous decision-making, stakeholder engagement, talent development, collaboration, adaptability, and self-accountability.

**You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality, operations, engineering, or supply chain leadership experience in a global manufacturing environment, including significant leadership of multi-site or enterprise quality functions.
* Demonstrated experience improving quality performance outcomes, including customer escapes, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, supplier quality, warranty, reliability, and launch quality.
* Strong experience in new product quality, design validation, process validation, launch readiness, reliability engineering, and quality risk management for complex product portfolios.
* Experience advancing digital quality capabilities, including eQMS, quality analytics, digital traceability, predictive insights, and AI-enabled risk detection.
* Proven ability to lead enterprise-level change across a complex, matrixed, global organization.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and executive presence, with the ability to translate quality priorities into business value.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Suggested Success Measures**

* Reduced customer escapes and repeat quality issues, with improved containment, responsiveness, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Improved cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, process capability, reliability, warranty performance, and on-time-to-customer impact from quality issues.
* Improved supplier quality performance through stronger qualification, development, governance, scorecards, and corrective action discipline.
* Stronger new product quality outcomes, including improved launch readiness, fewer launch defects, reduced warranty exposure, and better reliability performance.
* Expanded digital quality maturity, including predictive quality insights, AI-enabled risk detection, digital traceability, and enterprise quality intelligence.
* Increased quality maturity from reactive issue management to proactive prevention, measurable performance improvement, and stronger enterprise accountability.

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

+ nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
+ Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

+ We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
+ Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

- Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Pay Transparency**
nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply.
  
  
**Compensation Range**
$241,500.00 - $359,000.00
  
  
Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives.
  
  
**Benefit Overview**
At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

records.description:
Changing lives. Building Careers.
  
  
Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.
  
  
**Summary**
The VP, Corporate Quality Systems is a key member of the Quality Leadership Team (QLT) with responsibility to design, implement and oversee the Integra Global quality system, including identifying compliance improvement and remediation strategies across Integra LifeSciences. This role will work cross-functionally across all Integra facilities to build an integrated Quality system infrastructure that supports continued compliance across Integra sites. This role is crucial for ensuring the development, manufacture, and distribution of medical devices in compliance with corporate policies, U.S. Food and Drug Administration regulations, ISO 13485, the Canadian Medical Device Regulations (CMDR), the EU Medical Device Regulation, Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs Law, and other applicable regulatory agencies.
  
  
**SUPERVISION RECEIVED**
Reports to the Chief Quality Officer.
  
  
**SUPERVISION EXCERCISED**
Directly manages a Quality system corporate team (CAPA, NCE, Doc Control, Management Controls, Training/L&D, Audit/Compliance, Corporate Headquarters Site Quality, and Post Market Surveillance).
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily as follows:
  
  

* Build a high-performance quality culture and team, empowering and holding direct reports and cross-functional teams accountable for successful quality and compliance transformation. Leads with authority and influences globally across manufacturing and distribution facilities and cross functional stakeholders including but not limited to quality, product development, process technology, operations, supply chain, procurement, regulatory affairs, finance, and human resources.
* Develop organizational design and governance to achieve success. Provide strategic direction and communication of the quality transformation goals, creating a clear vision and integration with overall business objectives. Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of quality and compliance remediation. Highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Leads the design, execution and evolution of the Global Quality System for Integra in conjunction with the Compliance Master Plan (CMP) team, requiring cross-functional collaboration and understanding of various roles within the organization.
* Support interactions with regulatory bodies and ensure compliance with all applicable quality and safety standards. Responsible for leading the team with the review and finalizing any responses to regulatory authorities in collaboration with the Chief Quality Officer.
* Lead the identification, analysis, and resolution of quality issues and non-conformities across various departments in collaboration with the Quality Systems and CAPA teams. Ensure remediation efforts are managed through the QMS.
* Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the organization. Promote the use of lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance quality and operational efficiency. Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in quality management and remediation practices.
* Guide the activities required of the quality organization to ensure compliance with all appropriate regulations and standards, including FDA Part 820, ISO 13485, CMDR, MDR, MDSAP, and JPAL. Ensures compliance and readiness globally in collaboration with the QMS.

* Bachelor's degree is required, in engineering, science or closely related technical discipline is preferred. A master’s degree preferred.
* 18+ years of experience leading a team (direct reports or projects) or equivalent education and years of management experience
* Experience in highly regulated industries required, medical device and/or pharmaceutical preferred, including material remediation experience

Strong ability to influence across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Experienced with interacting with Executive leadership to execute decisions and manage risk.

records.title: Vice President Quality Control
records.description:
Shape the future of quality and patient trust. Join us as the Vice President, Global Quality Control and lead a world-class laboratory network that powers our clinical and commercial programs across the globe. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, you will set the enterprise strategy and build a unified, high-performing Quality Control organization that delivers reliable data, inspection-ready laboratories, and timely product release support—while advancing standardization, digital innovation, scientific excellence, and operational performance.
  
  
**Company Overview**
The work we do at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies has never been more important—and we are looking for talented candidates to join us. We are growing our locations, our capabilities, and our teams, and looking for passionate, mission-driven people like you who want to make a real difference in people’s lives.
  
  
Join FUJIFILM Biotechnologies and help make the next vaccine, cure, or gene therapy in partnership with some of the most innovative biopharma companies across the globe. We are proud to cultivate a culture that will fuel your passion, energy, and drive - what we call Genki.
  
  
Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers
  
  
**Job Description**
Your impact In this enterprise role, your leadership will directly influence patient safety, product quality, inspection outcomes, batch disposition timelines, and continuity of supply across a diverse global portfolio. You will advise senior executives on investment, capacity, technology, organizational design, and regulatory strategy—shaping multi‑year business and quality plans. Your decisions will strengthen client trust, accelerate revenue recognition, reduce the cost of quality, and protect the company’s license to operate.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Define and execute a global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi‑year roadmap across sites, modalities, and development phases. Establish enterprise standards, clear decision rights, and governance forums that enable consistent, phase‑appropriate control while allowing justified site or platform differences.
* Provide executive oversight of end‑to‑end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw‑material, in‑process, release, and stability testing; as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure capacity, prioritization, and flawless execution to meet program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure control strategies and specifications evolve appropriately through clinical development, process performance qualification, launch, and sustained commercial supply.
* Set global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance, principles that ensure data are attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate and complete, laboratory investigations, out of specification and out of trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise strategy and executive response for regulatory inspections and critical client audits.
* Build and deliver the digital and technology roadmap for laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, laboratory automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated deployment, master‑data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption that improve right‑first‑time outcomes and cycle time.
* Direct enterprise Quality Control capacity planning, capital prioritization, make‑versus‑buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and governance of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resiliency needs.
* Establish enterprise metrics and management review for on‑time testing and release support, lead time, invalid results, out of specification and out of trend rates, investigation cycle time, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Drive risk‑based priorities, Lean practices, and cross‑site learning to deliver sustainable improvement.
* Serve as the senior Quality Control liaison for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex laboratory, method, and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate technically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic, documented, and delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Define capabilities and succession plans, develop technical career paths and communities of practice, and cultivate a culture of scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Own escalation and coordinated response for significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, critical data‑integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk‑based decisions on testing strategy, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform other duties in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and company objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with fifteen or more years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization Quality Control; or a Master’s degree with ten or more years.
* Ten or more years of people leadership, including five or more years leading senior leaders with accountability for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control across development and commercial stages, including method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience with global regulatory inspections and client audits, and with complex out of specification, out of trend, data‑integrity, and laboratory‑compliance matters.
* Experience managing budgets, capital portfolios, headcount, capacity, external laboratories, and enterprise transformation in a matrixed global organization.
* Executive‑level communication and client‑facing experience in a regulated, technically complex environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration.
* Global leadership within a contract development and manufacturing organization supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing.
* Experience scaling Quality Control from clinical development through process performance qualification, launch, and sustained commercial supply.
* Working knowledge of the following: Food and Drug Administration; European Medicines Agency; Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency; Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency; International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; and European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; as well as applicable data‑integrity expectations.
* Experience deploying global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation.
* Credentials from the American Society for Quality, and training in Lean and Six Sigma or equivalent quality and operational excellence disciplines.

If you are a strategic, hands‑on executive who thrives at the intersection of science, operations, and leadership, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and help us raise the bar for quality worldwide.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
  
  
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level

records.description:
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Lead Quality Excellence in a Fast-Paced Manufacturing Environment**
We are seeking an experienced
**Head of Quality**
to lead our Quality organization and drive world-class performance across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing the Quality Management System, developing quality strategies, leading customer and supplier quality initiatives, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.
  
  

* Lead and maintain the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949 requirements.
* Develop and execute quality objectives, metrics, and improvement initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Manage customer and supplier quality activities, including audits, APQP, PPAP, launch readiness, corrective actions, and change management.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for internal and external quality issues.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor and report key quality metrics, including scrap, rework, and overall quality performance.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support production, new product launches, and supplier development.
* Build, develop, and lead high-performing quality teams.

**Success Competencies**
The Head of Quality embodies the following competencies:
  
  

* Manages Complexity: Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Decision Quality: Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
* Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm.
* Ensures Accountability: Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Drive Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
* Builds Effective Teams: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspective to achieve common goals.
* Communicates Effectively: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Instills Trust: Gaining the confidence and trust of others though honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Manages Ambiguity: Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
* Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.

Directly manages the Quality Department including the Quality Engineering, Quality Systems, Quality Planning, Quality Lab/ Gauging, Change and Series Management functions.
  
  
Your profile
