Job details:
 
**Strong engineering leader needed with extensive PCB & SMT experience / Relocation assistance available**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Christine McNamara
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Operations Leader to drive performance, efficiency, and team development within a fast-paced SMT / PCB manufacturing environment. This role will lead engineering and operations initiatives focused on continuous improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence, while developing and scaling a high-performing technical team.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings a strong Lean Manufacturing mindset, deep experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT/PCB), and the ability to drive accountability and measurable results across the organization.
 
 
\*\*Relocation assistance available for those not local to the area
 
 
 
**Why join us?**
Medical, Dental, Vision coverage
 
401(k) with company match
 
Relocation assistance
 
Annual performance bonus
 
Generous PTO & sick leave
 
 
 
**Job Details**
Key Responsibilities:
 
 
Operations & Continuous Improvement
 

* Lead Lean Manufacturing initiatives to improve throughput, yield, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Identify and drive process improvements across SMT lines, PCB assembly, and supporting operations
* Implement and sustain Lean tools (Kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping, standard work, etc.)
* Analyze production data to identify inefficiencies and drive corrective actions
* Reduce scrap, rework, and downtime through structured problem-solving methodologies

Engineering Leadership
 

* Oversee engineering activities related to process development, troubleshooting, and optimization
* Partner with production to resolve complex technical and process challenges
* Support new product introductions (NPI) and ensure smooth transition into production
* Drive best practices across SMT processes including soldering, reflow, pick-and-place, inspection, etc.

Team Development & Leadership
 

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers, technicians, and support staff
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for engineering and operations teams
* Identify skill gaps and implement training / development plans

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Partner with quality, supply chain, and production leadership to align operational goals
* Drive collaboration between engineering and manufacturing teams to improve execution
* Support customer needs and ensure alignment with delivery and quality expectations

Qualifications:
 
 
Required:
 

* 7–10+ years of experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT / PCB environment required)
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing technical teams (engineering or maintenance)
* Strong background in Lean Manufacturing / Continuous Improvement
* Hands-on experience with SMT processes (pick-and-place, reflow, inspection, etc.)
* Demonstrated success driving operational efficiency, process improvements, and accountability
* ITAR eligibility required; experience working in an ITAR-regulated environment is a strong plus
* Individual must be a US Citizen due to ITAR regulations

Preferred:
 

* IPC certification (IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, etc.)
* Experience with high-mix, low-volume or high-speed production environments
* Exposure to automation, process engineering, or advanced manufacturing technologies

records.title: Site Process & Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.

**More Than a Job: A Mission**

We seek a visionary leader to drive process and manufacturing excellence, designing and implementing advanced solutions that elevate operational performance. Join dedicated teams committed to transforming rail mobility, where your leadership shapes the future and leaves a lasting legacy.

**Your Role, Your Impact**

* Lead scalable process improvements to optimize manufacturing efficiency and support growth.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration between engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Ensure reliability and compliance in manufacturing operations through robust systems.
* Champion innovation by introducing new technologies and methodologies.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the site.

You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology.

**What You Bring**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or related field**
 .
* **Extensive manufacturing (industrial) engineering experience (ideally minimum 8-10 years), including proven leadership responsibilities**
 .
* Experience in working with an ERP (such as SAP) for Bill of Materials, Routings, Configuration follow-up.
* Working knowledge of Quality and Health & Safety standards and systems.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, process optimization, and industrial automation.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, regulatory standards, and operational excellence.
* Proven leadership, strategic thinking, and ability to inspire high-performing teams.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Achievement of delivery timelines and strategic manufacturing goals.
* Effective collaboration and leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
* Reduction in defects, increased efficiency, and proactive troubleshooting.

**Alstom, A Great Place to Grow**

* Work with cutting-edge technology and drive strategic vision.
* Make a global impact from our West Mifflin office.
* Advance your career through continuous learning and development.

Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
records.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
 
 
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
DESCRIPTION:
 
 
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
 
 
In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers. You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches. Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
 
 
As a member of the site leadership team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives. You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.
 
 
REQUIREMENTS:
 
 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Proficiency with quality management software systems
* Ability to travel up to 10%

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Work Model: This role can be performed remotely from an approved location, with flexibility based on business needs and applicable requirements.
 
 
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 
 
Reporting to the Vice President, Regal Rexnord Business System (RBS) for the Automation and Motion Control (AMC) Segment, the Continuous Improvement (RBS) Director for the AMC Segment serves as the strategic leader responsible for accelerating operational excellence and driving sustainable business performance improvements across assigned manufacturing sites. This role partners closely with site leadership teams to deploy CI (RBS) principles, develop leadership capabilities, improve operational metrics, and create a culture of continuous improvement.
 
 
The Director, RBS acts as both coach and change agent, ensuring that RBS tools and behaviors become integrated into daily management systems and leadership practices. Success in this role is measured by measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth, employee engagement, and overall business results.
 
 
The role is accountable for translating AMC strategic objectives into clear RBS roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives with the highest business impact, and ensuring disciplined execution through leaders, site teams, and RBS/CI talent. The Director, RBS will regularly communicate progress, risks, and business impact to segment and division leadership and will influence stakeholders outside of the direct function to align priorities, resources, and decisions.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
This Role Will Make an Immediate Impact By:
 
 

* Partner with site leadership teams to align operational strategies with division and enterprise objectives.
* Facilitate the development and execution of annual and multi-year operational strategies.
* Lead deployment of the Regal Business System across assigned facilities.
* Ensure site improvement priorities support commercial growth, profitability, customer service, and capacity requirements.
* Drive accountability for achievement of business objectives and key performance indicators.
* Drive a culture where performance gaps are addressed through structured problem solving.
* Partnering with division and segment leadership to prioritize improvement initiatives, recommend resource plans, and support staffing and talent decisions within the RBS/CI organization.

**Other Key Responsibilities Include**

* Assess site maturity and develop roadmaps to advance RBS capabilities.
* Standardize the use of RBS tools and systems across sites.
* Conduct regular RBS assessments, audits, and gemba reviews.
* Ensure sustainability of improvements through standard work and leader accountability.
* Coach site leaders on RBS principles, lean leadership, and continuous improvement behaviors.
* Develop leadership capability in daily management, problem solving, visual management, and accountability systems.
* Facilitate workshops, training sessions, and leadership development activities at sites.
* Build organizational capability to achieve self-sustaining continuous improvement.
* Establish and improve visual management systems throughout manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and support functions.
* Drive implementation and effectiveness of tiered accountability processes.
* Ensure performance measures are visible, actionable, and aligned to business objectives.
* Improve management routines to accelerate issue identification and resolution.
* Develop problem-solving capabilities at all levels of the organization.
* Facilitate Kaizen events, Rapid Improvement Events, and cross-functional improvement projects.
* Coach teams in root cause analysis methodologies including A3, 5 Whys, Fishbone, and PDCA.
* Ensure countermeasures are implemented, verified, and sustained.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing, operations, supply chain, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of continuous improvement, manufacturing or operations experience. Experience leading Lean/RBS transformation and maturity improvement across multiple sites, divisions, or business functions.
* Proven application of multiple CI tools, including 80/20, value stream mapping, 6S, flow, standard work, visual management, and structured problem solving.
* Black Belt in Lean/Continuous Improvement preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, influence senior leaders, and align cross-functional stakeholders around strategic improvement priorities.
* Experience developing CI/RBS talent, coaching leaders, and building organizational capability through formal training, Gemba coaching, and leader standard work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with plant teams, peers, executives, and external stakeholders as needed.
* Ability to travel up to 75% of the time to support assigned plants and divisions, regionally and internationally.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* MBA Preferred
* Lean deployment experience within a large, global, decentralized manufacturing environment.
* Industrial manufacturing industry experience.
* Knowledge of enterprise-wide business system tools or and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Experience in engineer-to-order or configure-to-order business environments.
* Experience improving transactional process areas such as customer care, engineering, finance, commercial, product management, or quote-to-cash.

**Pay Transparency**
Expected Base Salary Range: $132,000 – $205,600
 
 
The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for this position. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, the geographic market of that location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education and internal peer compensation comparisons among other potential factors.
 
 
**Export Controlled ITAR/EAR Compliance (Location & Position Dependent)**
Restrictions imposed by federal export control laws may limit this job opportunity to candidates who are a ‘U.S. Person’, which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted asylum in the United States, and refugees in the United States, or who otherwise can qualify for a license that permits them to hold the position.
 
 
**Sponsorship**
Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
 
 
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
 
 
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Posters
 
 
**Notification to Agencies**
: Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

records.title: Director, Value Stream Manufacturing
records.description:
**Director, Manufacturing Value Stream**
Global Value Stream As a Director on the Global Value Stream team, you will
*lead*
our Manufacturing value stream within HelloFresh's global supply chain, shaping the strategy and execution model for how we standardize, improve, and scale our operations worldwide. You will lead a team, set the department's operational agenda, and serve as a senior voice of operations across the organization. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of operations, technology, and global strategy.
 
 
***You will...***

* Define and execute the strategic direction for the portfolio of Manufacturing processes, owning the multi-year capability roadmap and global template.
* Lead and build a high-performing, accountable department with clear OKRs aligned to company strategy.
* Set the governance framework and operating model for how the Global Value Stream team designs, validates, and deploys process and technology standards internationally.
* Partner at the executive level with Operations, Product, Engineering, and others to align on global priorities, technology investments, and performance benchmarks.
* Serve as the final decision authority on process deviation requests, capability exceptions, and cross-market design trade-offs.
* Drive the organization's approach to continuous improvement, value stream analysis, and waste elimination at scale — setting the standard for how the company approaches process maturity.
* Ensure the team functions as an effective internal consultancy — providing rigorous expert support to regional operations, quality teams, and technology partners.

***You have...***

* 12–15+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing — including significant senior leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading multi-functional teams across multiple geographies, with full accountability for operational outcomes.
* Deep expertise across multiple supply chain functional domains, with a breadth of experience that enables credible leadership across the full Value Stream portfolio.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience managing department budgets and delivering measurable business impact.
* Extensive experience with global process standardization, operational technology ecosystems (WMS/WES/WCS/automation), and large-scale transformation programs.
* A track record of developing senior talent and building high-performance organizations.
* Experience operating as a senior stakeholder in cross-functional governance and product/technology lifecycle processes.
* Ability to travel up to 25%

***You are...***

* A bold, strategic leader with the operational depth to earn the trust of both warehouse teams and the C-suite.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity at the department level while maintaining clarity and pace for your team.
* A talent multiplier — known for developing strong leaders and creating organizations that outlast any individual.
* A rigorous, data-driven decision maker who moves fast without sacrificing quality or thoroughness.
* Passionate about building world-class operations at scale — energized by the complexity and impact of a global mandate.
* An outstanding communicator and influencer who can drive alignment across diverse cultures, functions, and levels of seniority.

**Additionally With This Role, You Will Have....**

* The opportunity to shape global operations at a leading food technology company with significant reach and impact.
* A high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
* Flexible working arrangements to support your work-life balance.

records.description:
**Director of Continuous Improvement**

* **Director of Continuous Improvement**
* **Greater Charlotte Area**
* **$170,000 to $200,000 + Bonus + Strong Company Benefits**

A leading global industrial manufacturer is seeking a Director of Continuous Improvement to drive operational excellence, Lean transformation, and productivity improvements across multiple manufacturing facilities. Reporting directly to the C-suite, this high-impact leadership role will be responsible for deploying enterprise-wide continuous improvement strategies, developing Lean capabilities, and delivering measurable gains in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance. If you're passionate about building high-performing operations, coaching teams, and leading large-scale Lean transformations, this is an outstanding opportunity to make a lasting impact within a growing international organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

* Lead the deployment of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement strategies across multiple manufacturing sites.
 
 Champion the use of Lean methodologies including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, SMED, TPM, and Six Sigma tools.
* Support plant leadership teams in identifying and executing operational improvement opportunities.
* Coach and mentor Plant Managers, Operations Leaders, CI Managers, and Production Leaders.
* Develop Lean competencies throughout the organization through training, workshops, and hands-on coaching.
* Support facility footprint optimization, cost reduction programs, and operational strategy deployment.
* Pioneer the implementation of digital manufacturing and Smart Factory technologies.
* Ensure operational excellence principles are embedded into daily management systems and site culture.

**The successful candidate will ideally have**
:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline,
* 10+ years of experience leading Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* 8+ years of experience applying Lean methodologies in high-volume industrial or automotive manufacturing operations.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost reduction.
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (CSSBB).
* Multi-Site Manufacturing experience

**Desired Skills and Experience**
\* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline,
 
\* 10+ years of experience leading Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
 
\* 8+ years of experience applying Lean methodologies in high-volume industrial or automotive manufacturing operations.
 
\* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost reduction.
 
\* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (CSSBB).
 
\* Multi-Site Manufacturing experience

records.title: Director Quality
records.description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for providing leadership and direction to Quality team(s) to ensure quality and compliance for the applicable products and processes for assigned department(s). Develop strategy, translate into functional plans and guide execution of long-term goals.

**Job Description**

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct the development of product specifications for Medline branded products; such as the testing requirements, procedures and methods for testing, inspecting or qualifying new products and suppliers.
* Partner with Supplier Audit department and Division to determine optimal Supplier relationship.
* Develop and implement strategy for the Quality department(s) based upon Quarterly Management Review.
* Prepare and deliver Customer presentations.
* Act as liaison with Senior Leadership of Divisions, Suppliers, Manufacturing, and/or Operations to ensure quality products, on time delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Suppliers, manufacturing partners and product managers in developing and implementing QA programs.
* Oversee QSR for assigned department(s) and ensure compliance as measured by FDA/ISO/internal audits.
* Management responsibilities include:
* Typically, manages through multiple Managers. Provides leadership and management to one or more major departments of an operating unit or to a department that has system-wide accountability.
* Strategic, tactical and operational planning (12 + months) for the function or department;
* Direct budgetary responsibility for one or more departments, functions or major projects/programs;
* Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects and develops;
* Recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies;
Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies. 

 

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or Technical Field.

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 7 years of experience related to the design/operation of medical device or drug combination product platforms, design controls, risk management, including working in compliance with QSR/GMP/ISO requirements or other regulated industries (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR).
* At least 4 years of management experience.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* Depth of technical knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR etc.)
* Proficiency in analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to control and coordinate concurrent projects, competing priorities and critical deadlines.
* Advanced level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using AVERAGE function, merging and centering cells, printing centered page and/or creating a pivot table).
Position requires travel up to 30% of the time for business purposes (within state, out of state and/or internationally). 

 

**PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* None

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 6 years of managerial experience preferred.
* At least 8 years of related experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food, Cosmetic, or Personal Products industries preferred.
* At least 2 years of experience working in a regulated environment involving human cells, tissues, or cellular or tissue-based products (HCT/Ps), with demonstrated experience applying applicable controls under **21 CFR Part 1271** , including Current Good Tissue Practice (CGTP) requirements, as applicable to product receipt, storage, handling, distribution, traceability, and quality oversight.
* Experience providing Quality oversight for **surgical procedure trays, loaner kits, or other assembled medical device configurations** , including applicable product specifications, component and supplier controls, configuration/change control, labeling, packaging, inspection/testing, nonconformance management, and release requirements.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* None

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

The anticipated salary range for this position:

$154,000.00 - $231,000.00 Annual

The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. This role is bonus and/or incentive eligible. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp.

We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page here .

Medline Industries, LP is an equal opportunity employer. Medline evaluates qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, neurodivergence, protected veteran status, marital or family status, caregiver responsibilities, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

records.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 
 
**Job Description**

**EXAMPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Set the global Digital Quality strategy and roadmap**
 + Define the target state, strategic themes, capability model, and multi-year roadmap for Digital Quality.
 + Maintain a portfolio of initiatives aligned with Quality objectives, regulatory priorities, enterprise architecture, and available investment.
 + Establish measurable outcomes, including compliance effectiveness, cycle-time reduction, right-first-time performance, user adoption, data quality, and realized benefits.
* **Lead end-to-end Quality process mapping and optimization**
 + Map current- and future-state processes across sites, regions, and GxP domains, including roles, decisions, controls, systems, data, handoffs, pain points, and performance measures.
 + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitize, automate, or retire processes before selecting technology.
 + Maintain process, capability, system, and data maps to support investment decisions, integration planning, and global standardization.
 + Partner with process owners to define requirements, target operating models, controls, and adoption plans.
* **Assess and recommend new digital tools**
 + Establish a consistent intake and assessment method for digital tools, platforms, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
 + Evaluate intended use, user need, business value, GxP impact, patient and product risk, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, interoperability, accessibility, scalability, supplier maturity, total cost, and support model.
 + Lead market scans, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, supplier due diligence, and fit-gap assessments.
 + Recommend whether to adopt, configure, integrate, scale, defer, or reject proposed solutions based on documented evidence.
 + Prevent technology-led implementations by confirming that each tool addresses a defined process need and has measurable success criteria.
* **Establish Digital Quality governance and assurance**
 + Define decision rights, design principles, architecture guardrails, stage gates, risk criteria, and governance forums for the Digital Quality portfolio.
 + Apply risk-based lifecycle assurance based on intended use and process risk, including requirements, supplier evidence, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, and retirement.
 + Set governance for AI-enabled Quality solutions, including approved use cases, human oversight, data provenance, model performance, explainability, monitoring, drift, retraining, and accountability for decisions.
 + Ensure electronic records, signatures, audit trails, integrations, master data, and reporting controls meet applicable regulatory and company expectations.
* **Drive implementation, adoption, and value realization**
 + Provide Quality leadership through product selection, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
 + Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement across global functions and sites.
 + Monitor solution performance, incidents, compliance signals, user feedback, benefits, and emerging risks throughout the lifecycle.
 + Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, budgets, resource needs, suppliers, and executive reporting.
* **Develop organizational capability**
 + Build digital literacy, process-mapping capability, product-management practices, and risk-based assurance skills across Quality.
 + Lead and develop internal staff and cross-functional teams; engage external specialists when needed.
 + Represent Quality in enterprise digital, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and investment forums.
 + Monitor evolving regulations, industry practices, and emerging technologies and translate them into practical Quality standards and roadmaps.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in Digital Quality, Quality systems, digital transformation, computer system assurance or validation, process excellence, product management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and delivering global digital programs across multiple functions, sites, or regions.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping, value-stream analysis, requirements definition, fit-gap assessment, and future-state design.
* Experience assessing and implementing digital platforms, SaaS solutions, workflow automation, analytics, data products, or AI-enabled tools.
* Knowledge of risk-based computer software assurance, computerized system validation, electronic records and signatures, data integrity, supplier assurance, and system lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing governance, prioritizing portfolios, preparing business cases, managing budgets, and measuring benefits.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, change-management, project, product, and vendor-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and lead multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise recommendations and decision materials.
* Ability to travel as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Quality, life sciences, engineering, information systems, business, data science, or a related discipline.
* Experience leading an enterprise Digital Quality strategy, capability model, or multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Experience with electronic quality management, document and learning management, laboratory, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, analytics, integration, or collaboration platforms.
* Experience conducting market scans, supplier due diligence, proofs of concept, pilots, and formal digital-tool evaluations.
* Experience applying product-management, enterprise-architecture, data-governance, or organizational change-management practices.
* Experience establishing governance for artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of cloud services, cybersecurity, privacy, integration patterns, master data, metadata, and third-party risk.
* Experience rationalizing application portfolios and supporting global process and technology standardization.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Expert understanding of global GxP Quality processes and the drug-development and product lifecycle, with the ability to connect process, data, technology, and control requirements.
* Strong knowledge of digital Quality platforms and how they support regulated business processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning risks and controls, including intended-use definition, human oversight, data provenance, performance criteria, monitoring, drift, change, and retraining governance.
* Ability to distinguish business criticality, GxP impact, and process risk and translate the assessment into proportionate assurance activities.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements, process maps, user requirements, evaluation criteria, roadmaps, and investment recommendations.
* Strong facilitation, critical-thinking, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to communicate direction, trade-offs, risks, status, and value to executives, steering committees, process owners, technical teams, and end users.

Commitment to global standardization while accommodating justified regional or functional requirements.

 
The salary range for this position is: $210,375.00 - $272,250.00. Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans\*.

For additional benefits information, visit:

https://www.gilead.com/careers/compensation-benefits-and-wellbeing

\* Eligible employees may participate in benefit plans, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

**For jobs in the United States:**
----------------------------------

Gilead Sciences Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment, and is dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment comprised of diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex , age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact ApplicantAccommodations@gilead.com for assistance.

postedPay.title: Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems

records.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk-takers, the trailblazers, the game-changers. We're not perfect, and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. But our drive is unrivaled, just like our athletes. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A day in the life:**
----------------------

As the Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems, you will own the design, implementation, and optimization of Monster's end-to-end supply chain planning landscape within the SAP ecosystem. Your primary focus is SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) covering demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, order based planning and the roadmap of S/4HANA.

You will also guide the connected Manufacturing and Quality solutions, including SAP PP, PP/DS, production execution, and SAP QM, so that planning decisions flow cleanly into the plant floor and quality processes. You will set global processes, solution architecture, and governance; lead a team of SAP IT professionals; and partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality leaders to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**The impact you'll make:**
---------------------------

***Supply Chain Planning (primary focus)***

* Own the global SAP planning solution, with SAP IBP and SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS) as the core platforms, and define the target architecture and roadmap, including to S/4HANA.
* Lead solution design and configuration decisions across demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, and response/deployment planning.
* Lead planning projects from inception to completion, including implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and migrations, delivered on time, in scope, and on budget.
* Establish planning master data standards, parameter governance, and integration between IBP/APO, S/4HANA, and connected systems (e.g., RTI, CPI).
* Serve as the point of contact on emerging trends in supply chain planning and evaluate solutions that improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and inventory performance.

***Manufacturing & Quality (supporting scope)***

* Oversee SAP production execution solutions so that plans translate into executable production schedules across plants and co-manufacturers.
* Guide SAP QM processes, including inspection planning, batch management, quality notifications, and release, in partnership with Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Ensure end-to-end integration across Planning, Manufacturing, and Quality so the business runs on one consistent process.

***Leadership & strategy***

* Analyze business requirements, prioritize based on cost/benefit, and present a clear implementation roadmap to IT and business leadership.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of SAP specialists and manage system integrator and partner relationships.
* Partner closely with end-to-end solution verticals to understand requirements, manage business risk, and deliver quality outcomes on budget and timeline.
* Engage operations leaders to identify problems suited to AI, automation, and advanced analytics, in line with the Digital Transformation (DT) roadmap and vision.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of SAP supply chain experience working on the IT side, including hands-on process mapping, solution design, configuration, and customization.
* **7+ years of hands-on SAP IBP and/or SAP APO experience**, including at least one full-lifecycle implementation you led or owned. APO-to-IBP migration experience strongly preferred.
* Working experience with SAP PP, and production execution, and exposure to SAP QM. Depth here is valued but secondary to Planning.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP SCM implementations as part of an IT team.
* Proven track record making solution design and roadmap decisions and leading SAP teams and system integrators.
* Experience aligning teams to a common business process and driving application adoption.

***Preferred***

records.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------

Hadrian is building an additive manufacturing capability that runs as part of an autonomous factory, not as a room full of printers. The hard problem is not any single machine, material, or line of code. It is making all of them behave as one system. Systems engineering is the glue that holds that system together, and this role owns the glue.

The Senior Director leads three engineering functions, materials and process engineering, hardware engineering, and software engineering, and is accountable for the digital backbone that binds them to each other and to applications engineering: the architecture, interfaces, and data that connect Hadrian’s Opus platform to cutting-edge additive manufacturing equipment, add automation where it makes sense, fuse sensor data into the part record, and turn a collection of parts into a full, integrated digital manufacturing system built around additive.

The measure of success is not three strong teams. It is one manufacturing system that a customer part flows through, from design intent to qualified hardware, with every decision and every data point captured along the way.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Architect the system.** Define and control the end-to-end architecture for additive at Hadrian: requirements, interfaces, data model, and acceptance criteria that hold across multiple equipment platforms, modalities, and sites. Treat the factory as the product.
* **Build the digital backbone.** Connect additive equipment, peripherals, and inspection assets to Opus with the same discipline a semiconductor fab applies to connecting tools to the host: standardized state models, telemetry, event streams, and data contracts, with security and configuration control built in.
* **Fuse the sensors.** Bring in-situ monitoring, machine telemetry, environmental data, and downstream inspection into one correlated record per part, then move from monitoring to data-driven release and, where it is justified, closed-loop control.
* **Automate where it pays.** Lead automation across additive cells (material and powder handling, build changeover, part removal and depowdering, post-processing flow, robotics, controls, and safety) with a written case for each: safety, repeatability, and data capture first; labor second. Never automate an unstable process.
* **Lead the three functions as one.** Set standards, priorities, and cadence for materials and process, hardware, and software engineering. Resolve conflicts between them at the architecture level, not the escalation level.
* **Own the applications engineering interface.** With the Head of Applications Engineering, define what a production-ready hand-off looks like, publish the process capability and design-rule data applications engineers build to, and close the loop from floor results back into design guidance.
* **Industrialize the equipment.** Through the hardware engineering leader, own factory and site acceptance, commissioning, reliability (preventive maintenance, spares, MTBF/MTTR), and configuration-controlled modification and upgrade of additive systems, and lead the technical relationships with equipment partners that unlock deeper integration. The machine-level depth lives in that team; the standards and the outcomes live here.
* **Design for the factory.** Partner with Factory Development and Factory Automation on cell and site design: material flow, capacity, simulation, utilities, and the path to lights-out operation for additive.
* **Build quality in.** Make the system itself the evidence: traceability, data integrity, and process control that stand up to AS9100 audits and customer qualification without a separate paper trail.
* **Be the additive voice in Hadrian’s platform.** Carry additive requirements into Core Engineering and the Opus roadmap, and bring platform capability back to the floor.
* **Hire, develop, and retain.** Build a leadership bench under you, set a high technical bar, and make Hadrian the place the best additive systems engineers in the country want to work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a physical science; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years in advanced manufacturing, with real depth in at least three of these six domains: factory design and industrial automation; semiconductor or other high-reliability capital-equipment engineering; manufacturing software and data systems; materials science and process engineering; quality systems in regulated industries; sensing, process monitoring, and sensor fusion.
* 5+ years leading engineering teams, including leading through managers and building at least one function from the ground up.
* Production experience with metal laser powder bed fusion, as a user of the equipment, a developer of it, or both.
* Has led the integration of complex equipment into factory-level software (manufacturing execution, equipment host, or data platforms), including requirements, interface standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Has taken at least one production automation or capital-equipment program (robotic cells, material handling, or equipment with safety systems and controls) from concept through commissioning in a regulated environment (aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical, or similar), and has owned the reliability of production equipment afterward.
* Fluent across the stack: can review a process flow, a data schema, a metallurgical cross-section, and a controls narrative in the same meeting, and knows which one is lying.
* Has worked as a true peer to a customer-facing or design function, with a record of building clean interfaces rather than absorbing the other team.
* Willing to travel up to 20%, including to Hadrian sites and international partners. Must meet the ITAR requirements below.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Ph.D. in materials science, mechanical engineering, systems engineering or a related discipline.
* Semiconductor capital-equipment background: equipment-to-host integration, tool matching, fleet data, fault detection and statistical process control at scale.
* Equipment-maker experience developing or launching metal additive systems (new product introduction, cost-productivity trades, design reviews) in addition to user-side experience.
* In-situ monitoring and sensor fusion implemented in production, with data-driven release or closed-loop control.
* Factory design: material flow planning, discrete-event simulation, and highly automated or lights-out operations.
* AS9100 and customer qualification pathways; familiarity with AM specifications (ASTM F42, ISO/ASTM 529xx, SAE AMS 7xxx series).
* Budget or P&L ownership of a capital-intensive program, with a record of making the build-versus-buy and automate-versus-wait calls well.
* Modern software fluency: APIs, event streaming, OT/IT architecture, industrial interoperability standards (OPC UA, MTConnect), and cloud data platforms.

**Compensation**
----------------

For this role, the target salary range is $300,000 - $350,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
 
 401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**
-----------------------

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

**Consideration of Criminal History**
-------------------------------------

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

**Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**
--------------------------------------------

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

Compensation Range: $300K - $350K

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Infrastructure
records.description:
Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed deep-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include the V-BAT aircraft, Hivemind Enterprise, and the Hivemind Vision product lines. With nine offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit Shield Open . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description**

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Manufacturing Infrastructure to lead the server and network infrastructure for our new 400,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in the Seattle-Tacoma area, home to our newest flagship product. You will own the systems and network engineering that keep the factory running, from build-out and commissioning through ramp to high-rate production, including compute, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, IT and OT networks, wireless, and the infrastructure behind manufacturing systems such as MES and PLM. You will lead a site-based team of systems and network engineers and partner closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Cybersecurity, Cloud Platform, Network Engineering, and Service Delivery.

This position is based on site in the Seattle, Tacoma, or surrounding SeaTac, WA area.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Own the infrastructure strategy, architecture, roadmap, and budget for the manufacturing facility.
* Lead technology readiness for the facility from design through construction, commissioning, and production ramp, working with Facilities, contractors, and Manufacturing Engineering.
* Build, lead, and develop an on-site team of systems and network engineers, including hiring, on-call coverage, and performance management.
* Own design and operation of the factory network, including core, access, wireless, IT/OT segmentation, and connectivity to Shield AI sites and cloud, in partnership with Network Engineering.
* Own server, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery infrastructure for manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP and PLM integrations (including Teamcenter), quality, and test systems.
* Provide management oversight for the servers, virtualization, storage, and network infrastructure that host and connect production systems and test and inspection equipment, partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, controls teams, and equipment vendors.
* Oversee site data center, MDF/IDF, and server room infrastructure, including capacity, power and cooling, cabling, and documentation, in coordination with Facilities.
* Partner with Cybersecurity to apply segmentation, patching, vulnerability management, and access controls aligned with NIST 800-171, CMMC, and ITAR requirements.
* Define uptime targets, change governance, and maintenance windows that fit production schedules; lead major incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Drive standardization, automation, and observability, and build repeatable site blueprints for future lines and facilities.
* Manage vendors, integrators, contracts, and budgets, and communicate site readiness, risks, and status to technical and executive stakeholders.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, network, or systems engineering, including 5+ years leading engineers, with direct experience supporting a manufacturing or production environment.
* Experience standing up or significantly expanding infrastructure for a new or large facility, from design through operations.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including switching, routing, wireless, segmentation, firewalls, and WAN connectivity.
* Experience designing and operating compute, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and Windows and Linux server environments.
* Experience supporting manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP, PLM, or quality platforms, and familiarity with how production equipment connects to the network.
* Strong understanding of high availability, capacity planning, patching, and monitoring in an environment where downtime affects output.
* Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, and developing technical talent.
* Experience managing vendors, budgets, and capital projects, with clear written and verbal communication.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Ability to participate in after-hours work and travel periodically to other Shield AI locations.
* This position may require access to export-controlled information, and employment may be contingent on U.S. person status or export authorization.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing, including ITAR and CUI environments.
* Experience with high-rate production ramp and Siemens Teamcenter or other MES platforms.
* Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, NetApp, Cohesity, Active Directory, and Entra ID.
* Experience with automation and infrastructure as code (PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform).
* Familiarity with OT security guidance such as IEC 62443 and industrial protocols such as OPC UA.
* Relevant networking, security, or infrastructure certifications (for example CCNP, CISSP, or ITIL).

Compensation Range: $200,240 - $300,360
